import MultiproofConeEndian

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.MultiproofConeCanonical
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisV8R19.DuplexFrames
open AspisR1.RetainedFieldByteCodec
open OraclePortCompactDraft
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

def bytesOf (xs : List U8) : Bytes := xs.map AspisV8R19.SqueezeOracleBridge.decodeByte

private theorem slice_four_succ (a b c d : AspisV8R19.DuplexFrames.Byte) (xs : Bytes) (j : Nat) :
    slice (a::b::c::d::xs) (4*(j+1)) 4 = slice xs (4*j) 4 := by
  unfold slice
  rw [show 4*(j+1)=4+4*j by omega, ← List.drop_drop]
  rfl

theorem canonical_four (a b c d : AspisV8R19.DuplexFrames.Byte) (xs : Bytes) :
    canonical (a::b::c::d::xs) ↔
      little [a,b,c,d] < 2147483647 ∧ canonical xs := by
  have hl : (a::b::c::d::xs).length = xs.length+4 := by simp
  have hd : (xs.length+4)/4 = xs.length/4+1 := by omega
  have hm : (xs.length+4)%4 = xs.length%4 := by omega
  simp only [canonical, List.mem_range, hl, hd, hm]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hmod,checks⟩
    refine ⟨?_,hmod,?_⟩
    · simpa only [slice, Nat.mul_zero, List.drop_zero, List.take_succ_cons, List.take_zero] using checks 0 (by omega)
    · intro j hj
      have hc := checks (j+1) (by omega)
      simpa only [slice_four_succ] using hc
  · rintro ⟨first,hmod,checks⟩
    refine ⟨hmod,?_⟩
    intro j hj
    cases j with
    | zero => simpa only [slice, Nat.mul_zero, List.drop_zero, List.take_succ_cons, List.take_zero] using first
    | succ j =>
      rw [slice_four_succ]
      exact checks j (by omega)

theorem word_four (a b c d : U8) :
    (core.num.U32.from_le_bytes (Array.make 4#usize [a,b,c,d])).val < 2147483647 ↔
      little (bytesOf [a,b,c,d]) < 2147483647 := by
  let word := Array.make 4#usize [a,b,c,d]
  have hb : List.ofFn (M31ParserArray.arrayBytes word) = bytesOf [a,b,c,d] := by rfl
  rw [← hb, MultiproofConeEndian.little_four]
  exact MultiproofConeEndian.strict_word_iff word

theorem words_meaning (xs : List U8) :
    MultiproofConeWordScan.wordsModel xs = true ↔ canonical (bytesOf xs) := by
  generalize hn : xs.length = n
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing xs with
  | h n ih =>
    cases xs with
    | nil => simp [MultiproofConeWordScan.wordsModel, bytesOf, canonical]
    | cons a xs =>
      cases xs with
      | nil => simp [MultiproofConeWordScan.wordsModel, bytesOf, canonical]
      | cons b xs =>
        cases xs with
        | nil => simp [MultiproofConeWordScan.wordsModel, bytesOf, canonical]
        | cons c xs =>
          cases xs with
          | nil => simp [MultiproofConeWordScan.wordsModel, bytesOf, canonical]
          | cons d xs =>
            have ht := ih xs.length (by simp only [List.length_cons] at hn; omega) xs rfl
            simp only [MultiproofConeWordScan.wordsModel, Bool.and_eq_true,
              decide_eq_true_eq, bytesOf, List.map_cons, canonical_four]
            exact and_congr (word_four a b c d) ht

/-- Exact total all-input refinement to the frozen parser's canonical predicate. -/
theorem scan_total (bytes : Slice U8) :
    MultiproofParserRef.parser_reference.canonical_words bytes =
      ok (decide (canonical (bytesOf bytes.val))) := by
  rw [MultiproofConeWordScan.words_total]
  apply congrArg ok
  have meaning := words_meaning bytes.val
  cases hb : MultiproofConeWordScan.wordsModel bytes.val with
  | true => simp [meaning.mp hb]
  | false =>
    have hn : ¬ canonical (bytesOf bytes.val) := by
      intro hc
      have hh := meaning.mpr hc
      rw [hb] at hh
      contradiction
    simp [hn]

#print axioms slice_four_succ
#print axioms canonical_four
#print axioms word_four
#print axioms words_meaning
#print axioms scan_total
end AspisR1.MultiproofConeCanonical
end

import CheckpointBytes5Decision
import MultiproofConeP6Frozen2Stage
import S7JoinQueryRows
import S8JoinFrozenScan

/-! Caller inputs only. This record organizes still-open source obligations;
it does not discharge them. In particular it contains no execution result,
accepted observation, oracle log, or arithmetic-output equality. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.S2LeadInterface
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1Stage2
open AspisV8R19.DuplexFrames AspisV8R19.SourceDuplexStep
open AspisV8R19.MemoizedProgramLaw AspisV8R19.OracleProgramOps
open MultiproofConeCanonical OraclePortCompactDraft

/-- Relevant caller positions, in execution order, not oracle events.
Query positions summarize the ten/twelve-step blocks, not individual queries. -/
inductive Site where
  | tx1 | batch0 | query0 | save | tx2 | resume | batch1 | query1 | finish
  deriving DecidableEq

def Site.rank : Site → Nat
  | .tx1 => 0 | .batch0 => 1 | .query0 => 2 | .save => 3 | .tx2 => 4
  | .resume => 5 | .batch1 => 6 | .query1 => 7 | .finish => 8

/-- Full account input/frame carrier; field preservation includes metadata. -/
structure Account where
  key : Bytes
  owner : Bytes
  lamports : Nat
  data : Bytes
  signer : Bool
  writable : Bool
  executable : Bool
  rentEpoch : Nat

/-- Data supplied by a concrete caller refinement, never fabricated by compose.
The proof/public fields record retained input snapshots even at positions
where a callee does not consume both arguments. -/
structure Inputs (Observer : Type) where
  reached : Site → Prop
  clock : Site → Nat
  proof : Site → Slice U8
  publicInput : Site → Slice U8
  proofAccount : Site → Bytes
  checkpoint : Site → Slice U8
  nodes : Nat → Nat → Slice U8
  y1 : Slice U8
  observer : Site → Option Observer
  before : Site → Nat → Account
  after : Site → Nat → Account

/-- Only the admitted verifier adapter's TX1 account2 data write is allowed.
Pool settlement and CPI effects are a separate caller cone. -/
def dataWrite (s : Site) (a : Nat) : Bool := decide (s = .tx1 ∧ a = 2)

/-- The separate extraction has a distinct trait structure. Transport its
implementation fields explicitly; source adoption of this port remains P6. -/
def multiproofDigest {Hash : Type} (D : aspis_core.digest.Digest32 Hash) :
    MultiproofConeRef.aspis_core.digest.Digest32 Hash :=
  ⟨D.coremarkerCopyInst, D.digest⟩

/-- These are input-buffer identities, dispatch facts and account framing.
`oracle` is deliberately the stronger total multiproof per-call law; the
checkpoint's success-conditioned law is DERIVED from it below. No arbitrary
Prop boundary, source output, log or observation equality is a field. -/
structure S2CallerFacts {Observer Hash : Type} (c : Inputs Observer)
    (D : aspis_core.digest.Digest32 Hash) (hash : Hash) (H : Bytes → State)
    (stored pub savedBytes : Bytes) (parsed : Parsed) : Prop where
  proofBytes : ∀ s, c.reached s → bytesOf (c.proof s).val = stored
  publicBytes : ∀ s, c.reached s → bytesOf (c.publicInput s).val = pub
  proofSuffix : ∀ s, c.reached s → s = .tx1 ∨ s = .tx2 →
    c.proofAccount s = (c.proofAccount s).take 688 ++ stored
  proofLength : stored.length = 57607
  checkpointBytes : ∀ s, c.reached s → s = .save ∨ s = .tx2 ∨ s = .resume →
    bytesOf (c.checkpoint s).val = savedBytes
  checkpointLength : savedBytes.length = 1768
  nodeViews : ∀ b k, b < 2 → k < 3 → bytesOf (c.nodes b k).val =
    slice parsed.wire (OraclePortSelectedDraft.slotStart (3*b+k))
      (32*OraclePortSelectedDraft.capacity (3*b+k))
  y1Input : c.reached .tx1 → c.y1 = S8JoinFrozenScan.segment (c.proof .tx1) 7031 464
  observerNone : ∀ s, c.reached s → c.observer s = none
  reachedPrefix : ∀ s t, s.rank < t.rank → c.reached t → c.reached s
  callOrder : ∀ s t, s.rank < t.rank → c.reached s → c.reached t → c.clock s < c.clock t
  accountFrame : ∀ s, c.reached s → ∀ a, dataWrite s a = false → c.after s a = c.before s a
  writtenMetadata : c.reached .tx1 →
    {c.after .tx1 2 with data := (c.before .tx1 2).data} = c.before .tx1 2
  oracle : ∀ input, D.digest hash input = ok (MultiproofConePhysicalTransport.rawOracle H input)

/-- The SDK packet frames the 58295-byte account allocation, whereas the
lead consumes only the selected 57607-byte suffix. Use the actual range
result to cross this boundary; neither an address nor a length suffices. -/
theorem proof_suffix_bytes (account selected : Slice U8)
    (range : selected.val = (account.val.drop 688).take 57607) :
    bytesOf selected.val = slice (bytesOf account.val) 688 57607 := by
  rw [range]
  simp only [bytesOf, slice, List.map_take, List.map_drop]

/-- A total raw digest law implies the weaker checkpoint interpretation.
The byte/state carrier roundtrip is explicit, not an extra oracle premise. -/
theorem checkpoint_oracle {Hash : Type} (D : aspis_core.digest.Digest32 Hash)
    (hash : Hash) (H : Bytes → State)
    (law : ∀ input, D.digest hash input = ok (MultiproofConePhysicalTransport.rawOracle H input)) :
    CheckpointBytes5Inputs.Oracle D hash H := by
  intro input digest success
  have he := Result.ok.inj ((law input).symm.trans success)
  subst digest
  change AspisV8R19.SqueezeOracleBridge.decodeState
    (AspisV8R19.SqueezeOracleBridge.encodeState (H (AspisV8R19.SqueezeOracleBridge.flatten input))) = _
  exact AspisV8R19.SqueezeOracleBridge.state_roundtrip _

/-- Exact checkpoint caller premise, at either reached writer or reader site. -/
theorem checkpoint_binding {Observer Hash : Type} (c : Inputs Observer)
    (D : aspis_core.digest.Digest32 Hash) (hash : Hash) (H : Bytes → State)
    (stored pub ck : Bytes) (parsed : Parsed)
    (facts : S2CallerFacts c D hash H stored pub ck parsed)
    (s : Site) (reached : c.reached s) :
    CheckpointBytes5Join.S2S10CallerBinding D hash H (c.proof s) (c.publicInput s) stored pub :=
  ⟨facts.proofBytes s reached, facts.publicBytes s reached,
    checkpoint_oracle D hash H facts.oracle⟩

/-- Compose S2 inputs with the existing S7 trace/initialization results.
The actual source PushTrace is supplied by the lead's S7 cone, NOT by S2.
The initial Progress conclusion refers only to the constructed initial state;
it is not silently identified with the resumed source accumulator. -/
theorem compose {Observer Hash : Type} (c : Inputs Observer)
    (D : aspis_core.digest.Digest32 Hash) (hash : Hash) (H : Bytes → State)
    (stored pub ck : Bytes) (parsed : Parsed)
    (facts : S2CallerFacts c D hash H stored pub ck parsed)
    (save : c.reached .save) (resume : c.reached .resume)
    (old : S8OwnedP6Finish.Weights) (size : old.val.length = 64)
    (state : S7Kani2AccumulatorLoop.BatchedWeights) (sum : S7Kani3CallerTrace.Sum)
    (history : S7Kani3CallerTrace.PushTrace old state sum) :
    CheckpointBytes5Join.S2S10CallerBinding D hash H (c.proof .save) (c.publicInput .save) stored pub ∧
    CheckpointBytes5Join.S2S10CallerBinding D hash H (c.proof .resume) (c.publicInput .resume) stored pub ∧
    (∀ b k, b < 2 → k < 3 → bytesOf (c.nodes b k).val =
      slice parsed.wire (OraclePortSelectedDraft.slotStart (3*b+k))
        (32*OraclePortSelectedDraft.capacity (3*b+k))) ∧
    S7JoinRowsTrace.Progress 0 0
      (⟨S7Kani3CallerTrace.initialRaw old,0#usize⟩ : S7Kani2AccumulatorLoop.BatchedWeights) ∧
    S8Kani2CallerJoin.CallerInvariant state.raw old sum := by
  exact ⟨checkpoint_binding c D hash H stored pub ck parsed facts .save save,
    checkpoint_binding c D hash H stored pub ck parsed facts .resume resume,
    facts.nodeViews, S7JoinQueryRows.initial_progress old size,
    S7Kani3CallerTrace.reached_invariant old state sum history⟩

/-- Install all six physical slot views in the existing P6 batch join.
Local callback gates stay explicit; no whole-batch equality is assumed. -/
theorem multiproof_join {Observer Hash : Type} (c : Inputs Observer)
    (D : aspis_core.digest.Digest32 Hash) (hash : Hash) (H : Bytes → State)
    (stored pub ck : Bytes) (parsed : Parsed)
    (facts : S2CallerFacts c D hash H stored pub ck parsed)
    (binary occupied sibling : MultiproofConeP6Callbacks.Parent)
    (leaf : MultiproofConeP6Batch.Leaf)
    (p6 : MultiproofConeP6Frozen2Stage.P6Boundary (multiproofDigest D) hash H binary occupied sibling leaf)
    (q : Fin 22 → Fin 262144) :
    (∀ s, (eval H (MultiproofConeP6Frozen2Stage.sourceBatch occupied sibling leaf parsed q c.nodes 0 s)).2 = true →
      eval H (MultiproofConeP6Frozen2Stage.sourceBatch occupied sibling leaf parsed q c.nodes 0 s) =
        eval H (OraclePortFrozen2.batch parsed q OraclePortFrozen2.batch0)) ∧
    (∀ s, (eval H (MultiproofConeP6Frozen2Stage.sourceBatch occupied sibling leaf parsed q c.nodes 1 s)).2 = true →
      eval H (MultiproofConeP6Frozen2Stage.sourceBatch occupied sibling leaf parsed q c.nodes 1 s) =
        eval H (OraclePortFrozen2.batch parsed q OraclePortFrozen2.batch1)) :=
  MultiproofConeP6Frozen2Stage.both_batches (multiproofDigest D) hash H binary occupied sibling leaf
    {p6 with oracle := facts.oracle} parsed q c.nodes facts.nodeViews

/-- Exact y1 callee input, with accepted parser provenance kept separate. -/
theorem y1_join {Observer Hash : Type} (c : Inputs Observer)
    (D : aspis_core.digest.Digest32 Hash) (hash : Hash) (H : Bytes → State)
    (stored pub ck : Bytes) (parsed : Parsed)
    (facts : S2CallerFacts c D hash H stored pub ck parsed)
    (reached : c.reached .tx1) (tr : RawCutTranscriptRun.ErasedPrefix)
    (parser : OraclePortStoredParserC4.parseReached stored tr = some parsed) :
    S8OwnedP6.check_values_owned c.y1 = ok (.Ok ()) := by
  rw [facts.y1Input reached]
  apply S8JoinFrozenScan.parsed_y1 (c.proof .tx1) tr parsed
  change OraclePortStoredParserC4.parseReached (bytesOf (c.proof .tx1).val) tr = some parsed
  rw [facts.proofBytes .tx1 reached]
  exact parser

#print axioms proof_suffix_bytes
#print axioms checkpoint_oracle
#print axioms checkpoint_binding
#print axioms compose
#print axioms multiproof_join
#print axioms y1_join
end AspisR1.S2LeadInterface
end

S2Z_Oracle.text:
import AdapterRwModel
import S2LeadInterface

/-! Per-call transport for the adopted owned extraction. The native op43
binding and runtime SHA256 interpretation remain explicit obligations.
P1 is used only as the realization of the ideal oracle in the ROM experiment;
no deterministic SHA256 random-oracle theorem or per-trace equality is claimed. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.S2Z.Oracle
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisV8R19.DuplexFrames AspisV8R19.SourceDuplexStep
abbrev Parts := Slice (Slice U8)
abbrev Digest := Array U8 32#usize

/-- Nominal dictionary transport, preserving the actual extracted op43. -/
def leadDigest (ops : AdapterRw.Ops) :
    AspisR1Stage2.aspis_core.digest.Digest32 AdapterRw.SolanaDigest :=
  { coremarkerCopyInst := (AdapterRw.SolanaDigest.Insts.Aspis_coreDigestDigest32 ops).coremarkerCopyInst
    digest := (AdapterRw.SolanaDigest.Insts.Aspis_coreDigestDigest32 ops).digest }

/-- Native wrapper/ABI interpretation, not installed by parameterization. -/
def NativeBinding (ops : AdapterRw.Ops) (hashv : Parts → Result Digest) : Prop :=
  ∀ self parts, ops.op43 self parts = hashv parts

/-- Returning hashv/sol_sha256 semantics on the exact flattened byte input.
This does not assert that every input returns; VM aborts remain outside it. -/
def RuntimeSyscall (hashv : Parts → Result Digest) (sha256 : Bytes → State) : Prop :=
  ∀ parts digest, hashv parts = ok digest →
    AspisV8R19.SqueezeOracleBridge.decodeState digest =
      sha256 (AspisV8R19.SqueezeOracleBridge.flatten parts)

/-- Fixed-oracle realization of P1 in the existing ideal experiment. This is
an experiment premise, never a theorem that SHA256 is a random function. -/
def P1Realization (sha256 H : Bytes → State) : Prop := ∀ bytes, sha256 bytes = H bytes

/-- Each successful digest of the actual owned dictionary has the ideal value.
Quantification is over calls; no trace or successful verifier is a premise. -/
theorem successful_call (ops : AdapterRw.Ops) (hashv : Parts → Result Digest)
    (sha256 H : Bytes → State) (binding : NativeBinding ops hashv)
    (runtime : RuntimeSyscall hashv sha256) (p1 : P1Realization sha256 H) :
    CheckpointBytes5Inputs.Oracle (leadDigest ops) () H := by
  intro parts digest returned
  change ops.op43 () parts = ok digest at returned
  rw [binding] at returned
  exact (runtime parts digest returned).trans (p1 _)

/-- Exact stronger lead field, conditional on total native syscall return.
Totality is named separately; success-conditioned ROM interpretation alone
cannot discharge it. No conclusion is hidden in a new trusted structure. -/
theorem total_call (ops : AdapterRw.Ops) (hashv : Parts → Result Digest)
    (sha256 H : Bytes → State) (binding : NativeBinding ops hashv)
    (runtime : ∀ parts, hashv parts = ok
      (AspisV8R19.SqueezeOracleBridge.encodeState
        (sha256 (AspisV8R19.SqueezeOracleBridge.flatten parts))))
    (p1 : P1Realization sha256 H) :
    ∀ parts, (leadDigest ops).digest () parts =
      ok (MultiproofConePhysicalTransport.rawOracle H parts) := by
  intro parts
  change ops.op43 () parts = _
  rw [binding, runtime, p1]
  rfl

/-- The original extraction dictionary and transported dictionary perform the
same call, including failure/divergence; no ideal interpretation is needed. -/
theorem dictionary_call (ops : AdapterRw.Ops) (self : AdapterRw.SolanaDigest)
    (parts : Parts) :
    (leadDigest ops).digest self parts =
      (AdapterRw.SolanaDigest.Insts.Aspis_coreDigestDigest32 ops).digest self parts := rfl

#print axioms successful_call
#print axioms total_call
#print axioms dictionary_call
end AspisR1.S2Z.Oracle
end

S2W_ExtractionBoundary.text:
import S2W_FinalAudit
import S2X_SecondCut

/-! D188: correspondence of the owned Rust functions to the extracted source
semantics is a named project trust item. It is not an S2 source-proof goal.
Non-extracted AccountInfo wrappers are deliberately outside this record. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.S2W_ExtractionBoundary
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1.AdapterRw MultiproofConeCanonical
open AspisV8R19.DuplexFrames AspisV8R19.SourceDuplexStep
abbrev Accounts := Slice Cuts.Account
abbrev Program := AdapterRw.solana_pubkey.Pubkey
abbrev Slot := core.result.Result U64 Cuts.PE
abbrev First := Program → Accounts → Slice U8 → Result (core.result.Result (alloc.vec.Vec U8) Cuts.PE)
abbrev Second := Program → Accounts → Slice U8 → Slot → Result (core.result.Result Unit Cuts.PE)

/-- Exactly the project extraction boundary, including the extracted digest
installation. No account frame, site observation, accepted result, input-buffer
identity, checkpoint persistence, or caller-facts proposition is a field.
Binary correspondence remains rustc/P7 and S10, outside this source theorem. -/
structure AeneasExtraction (ops : AdapterRw.Ops) (native1 : First) (native2 : Second)
    (hashv : S2Z.Oracle.Parts → Result S2Z.Oracle.Digest) : Prop where
  stage1 : ∀ program accounts data,
    native1 program accounts data = AdapterRw.r1_pool_adapter.owned.stage1_owned ops program accounts data
  stage2 : ∀ program accounts data slot,
    native2 program accounts data slot = AdapterRw.r1_pool_adapter.owned.stage2_owned ops program accounts data slot
  digest : ∀ self parts, ops.op43 self parts = hashv parts

/-- P1 and RuntimeSyscall are separately named records; neither assumes the
caller's oracle field, source acceptance, or a returning-domain restriction. -/
structure P1 (sha256 H : Bytes → State) : Prop where
  realization : S2Z.Oracle.P1Realization sha256 H
structure RuntimeSyscall (hashv : S2Z.Oracle.Parts → Result S2Z.Oracle.Digest)
    (sha256 : Bytes → State) : Prop where
  returningValue : S2Z.Oracle.RuntimeSyscall hashv sha256

/-- Every accepted pair of the native owned entry functions has ONE exact
ordered source observation, with the actual typed calls/arguments/returns.
Both accepted executions use the SAME Ops. Internal child events are still
provided by the separately named child cone joins, as D188 requires. -/
theorem accepted_native_observation (ops : AdapterRw.Ops) (native1 : First) (native2 : Second)
    (hashv : S2Z.Oracle.Parts → Result S2Z.Oracle.Digest)
    (extraction : AeneasExtraction ops native1 native2 hashv)
    (program : Program) (accounts1 accounts2 : Accounts) (data1 data2 : Slice U8)
    (slot : Slot) (checkpoint : alloc.vec.Vec U8)
    (accepted1 : native1 program accounts1 data1 = ok (.Ok checkpoint))
    (accepted2 : native2 program accounts2 data2 slot = ok (.Ok ())) :
    ∃ firstLog finalLog suffix,
      S2W_Trace.run ops (S2W_Outer.stage1_owned ops S2W_Outer.traceEffects program accounts1 data1)
        [] = ok (.Ok checkpoint,firstLog) ∧
      S2W_Trace.run ops (S2W_Outer.stage2_owned ops S2W_Outer.traceEffects program accounts2 data2 slot)
        firstLog = ok (.Ok (),finalLog) ∧
      S2W_Trace.run ops (S2W_Observation.two ops program accounts1 data1 accounts2 data2 slot) [] =
        ok (.Ok checkpoint,finalLog) ∧
      finalLog = firstLog ++ suffix ∧
      (∀ e ∈ finalLog, S2W_TraceFacts.ValidEvent ops e) := by
  rw [extraction.stage1] at accepted1
  rw [extraction.stage2] at accepted2
  obtain ⟨firstLog,finalLog,suffix,first,second,both,extension⟩ :=
    S2W_Observation.accepted_segments ops program accounts1 data1 accounts2 data2 slot checkpoint
      accepted1 accepted2
  exact ⟨firstLog,finalLog,suffix,first,second,both,extension,
    S2W_TraceFacts.run_valid ops _ [] finalLog _ (by simp) both⟩

/-- NativeBinding is discharged by the named extraction boundary, not retained
as another S2 premise. No totality is introduced, including for multiproof. -/
theorem native_oracle (ops : AdapterRw.Ops) (native1 : First) (native2 : Second)
    (hashv : S2Z.Oracle.Parts → Result S2Z.Oracle.Digest)
    (extraction : AeneasExtraction ops native1 native2 hashv)
    (sha256 H : Bytes → State) (p1 : P1 sha256 H) (runtime : RuntimeSyscall hashv sha256) :
    CheckpointBytes5Inputs.Oracle (S2Z.Oracle.leadDigest ops) () H :=
  S2W_SuccessOracle.native_success_field ops hashv sha256 H extraction.digest
    runtime.returningValue p1.realization

/-- Actual native TX1 call arguments, proofLength and proofSuffix, now with
no residual owned-native association obligation. The nine-site projection is
not identified with an independently supplied Inputs record. -/
theorem native_first_fields (ops : AdapterRw.Ops) (native1 : First) (native2 : Second)
    (hashv : S2Z.Oracle.Parts → Result S2Z.Oracle.Digest)
    (extraction : AeneasExtraction ops native1 native2 hashv)
    (program : Program) (accounts : Accounts) (data : Slice U8)
    (checkpoint : alloc.vec.Vec U8)
    (accepted : native1 program accounts data = ok (.Ok checkpoint)) :
    ∃ proofAccount publicAccount publicInput raw statement semantic proof split,
      Slice.index_usize accounts 0#usize = ok proofAccount ∧
      Slice.index_usize accounts 1#usize = ok publicAccount ∧
      AdapterRw.r1_pool_adapter.owned.OwnedAccount.data ops proofAccount = ok (.Ok raw) ∧
      AdapterRw.r1_pool_adapter.owned.OwnedAccount.data ops publicAccount = ok (.Ok publicInput) ∧
      ops.op47 publicInput = ok (.Ok statement) ∧
      AdapterRw.first_decoded ops semantic publicInput proof split = ok (.Ok checkpoint) ∧
      (bytesOf proof.val).length = 57607 ∧
      bytesOf raw.val = (bytesOf raw.val).take 688 ++ bytesOf proof.val := by
  rw [extraction.stage1] at accepted
  exact LeadInputs.first_byte_fields ops program accounts data checkpoint accepted

#print axioms accepted_native_observation
#print axioms native_oracle
#print axioms native_first_fields
#print AeneasExtraction
#print P1
#print RuntimeSyscall
end AspisR1.S2W_ExtractionBoundary
end

import S2W_WrapperLaws
import S2X_RuntimeRetention

/-! Entry/write/history composition at the interpreted heap boundary. The
ledger version premise is the existing one, applied to the computed write
and actual entry payload, with no savedAtWrite or independent cut equality.
This does not identify the native Rust wrapper's allocation/copy operation
with the Heap interpreter; that source port remains separate. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.S2W_EntryWriteHistory
open S2Trust S2W_TrustedStd S2W_WrapperLaws AdapterRw
open AspisV8R19.DuplexFrames

def payloadBytes (encode : UInt8 → AspisV8R19.DuplexFrames.Byte) (p : Payload) (n : Nat) : Bytes :=
  List.ofFn (fun i : Fin n => encode (p.contents i.val))

/-- Pointwise wrapper bytes lift to the SAME serialized checkpoint. -/
theorem written_bytes {F : Type} (encode : UInt8 → AspisV8R19.DuplexFrames.Byte)
    (s : Heap F) (a t o : Nat) (src : Payload)
    (empty : s.guards = []) (zero : s.counter (s.accounts a).1 = 0)
    (length : (s.payload (s.accounts a).1).descriptor.length = 1768) :
    payloadBytes encode ((writeBracket s a t o src).payload (s.accounts a).1) 1768 =
      payloadBytes encode src 1768 := by
  apply congrArg List.ofFn
  funext i
  exact congrArg encode ((checkpoint_write s a t o src empty zero length).1 i.val i.isLt)

/-- Single computed write, protected transaction history, actual TX2 shared
acquisition/read/drop. The loaded entry bytes are derived, not separately
assumed at save/tx2/resume sites. Runtime account indices remain explicit. -/
theorem entry_write_history {W F : Type} (L : Library W F)
    (trust : S2TrustedSdkBorrow L) (encode : UInt8 → AspisV8R19.DuplexFrames.Byte)
    (savedState entryState : Heap F) (w : W)
    (writer reader writeToken writeOwner readToken readOwner : Nat) (src : Payload)
    (empty : savedState.guards = [])
    (zero : savedState.counter (savedState.accounts writer).1 = 0)
    (length : (savedState.payload (savedState.accounts writer).1).descriptor.length = 1768)
    (keys : Nat → List UInt8) (n : Nat)
    (entry : RuntimeEntrypointAdmission entryState keys n) (within : reader < n)
    (related : L.related w entryState)
    (version : S2X.CheckpointVersionBinding
      (payloadBytes encode ((writeBracket savedState writer writeToken writeOwner src).payload
        (savedState.accounts writer).1) 1768)
      (payloadBytes encode (entryState.payload (entryState.accounts reader).1) 1768)) :
    payloadBytes encode (entryState.payload (entryState.accounts reader).1) 1768 =
      payloadBytes encode src 1768 ∧
    (payloadBytes encode src 1768).length = 1768 ∧
    ∃ acquired read done,
      L.run w (.shared reader readToken readOwner) = (acquired,.guard readToken) ∧
      L.run acquired (.deref readToken) =
        (read,.payload (entryState.payload (entryState.accounts reader).1)) ∧
      L.run read (.drop readToken) = (done,.unit) ∧ L.related done entryState := by
  refine ⟨?_,?_,native_snapshot_protocol L trust w entryState keys n reader readToken
    readOwner entry within related⟩
  · exact (S2X.checkpoint_persistence _ _ version).trans
      (written_bytes encode savedState writer writeToken writeOwner src empty zero length)
  · exact List.length_ofFn

#print axioms written_bytes
#print axioms entry_write_history
end AspisR1.S2W_EntryWriteHistory

S2W_CommittedCheckpoint.text:
import S2W_EntryWriteHistory
import S2W_D188Consolidation

/-! Commit-indexed checkpoint composition. The history premise is indexed to
THE COMPUTED POST-WRITE PAYLOAD, rather than to the returned vector. This
removes a savedAtCommit substitution from the local composition. This module
makes no claim that writeBracket is already the native AccountInfo wrapper. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.S2W_CommittedCheckpoint
open S2Trust S2W_TrustedStd S2W_WrapperLaws S2W_EntryWriteHistory
open AspisV8R19.DuplexFrames

def source (bytes : List UInt8) : Payload :=
  ⟨⟨0,bytes.length,0⟩,fun i => bytes[i]?.getD 0⟩

theorem source_bytes (encode : UInt8 → AspisV8R19.DuplexFrames.Byte) (bytes : List UInt8) :
    payloadBytes encode (source bytes) bytes.length = bytes.map encode := by
  apply List.ext_getElem
  · simp [payloadBytes]
  · intro i left right
    simp [payloadBytes,source]

/-- Kani's arbitrary-coordinate copy contract lifts symbolically, without
reducing 1768 entries. The runtime version is associated with the computed
account write, then transported to the returned serialization. -/
theorem committed_version {F : Type} (encode : UInt8 → AspisV8R19.DuplexFrames.Byte)
    (heap : Heap F) (account token owner : Nat) (saved : List UInt8)
    (loaded : Bytes) (empty : heap.guards = [])
    (zero : heap.counter (heap.accounts account).1 = 0)
    (destinationSize : (heap.payload (heap.accounts account).1).descriptor.length = 1768)
    (savedSize : saved.length = 1768)
    (version : S2X.CheckpointVersionBinding
      (payloadBytes encode ((writeBracket heap account token owner (source saved)).payload
        (heap.accounts account).1) 1768) loaded) :
    loaded = saved.map encode ∧
    Nonempty (S2W_AuthenticatedInputs.CheckpointVersionBinding (saved.map encode) loaded) := by
  have written := written_bytes encode heap account token owner (source saved)
    empty zero destinationSize
  have same : payloadBytes encode ((writeBracket heap account token owner (source saved)).payload
      (heap.accounts account).1) 1768 = saved.map encode := by
    rw [written,← savedSize]
    exact source_bytes encode saved
  have rebound : S2X.CheckpointVersionBinding (saved.map encode) loaded := by
    rw [← same]
    exact version
  exact ⟨S2X.checkpoint_persistence _ _ rebound,⟨⟨rebound⟩⟩⟩

#print axioms source_bytes
#print axioms committed_version
end AspisR1.S2W_CommittedCheckpoint

S2W_ReturnedCheckpoint.text:
import S2W_CommittedCheckpoint

/-! Canonical conversion of the ACTUAL returned Aeneas vector to the SDK
payload carrier. No independent source-byte representation equality assumed. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.S2W_ReturnedCheckpoint
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std S2Trust S2W_WrapperLaws S2W_EntryWriteHistory S2W_CommittedCheckpoint
open MultiproofConeCanonical AspisV8R19.DuplexFrames

def encode (byte : UInt8) : AspisV8R19.DuplexFrames.Byte := byte.toFin
def nativeByte (byte : U8) : UInt8 := UInt8.ofNat byte.val
def nativeBytes (saved : alloc.vec.Vec U8) : List UInt8 := saved.val.map nativeByte

theorem byte_representation (byte : U8) :
    encode (nativeByte byte) = AspisV8R19.SqueezeOracleBridge.decodeByte byte := by
  apply Fin.ext
  change (UInt8.ofNat byte.val).toNat = byte.val
  exact UInt8.toNat_ofNat_of_lt' byte.bv.isLt

theorem vector_representation (saved : alloc.vec.Vec U8) :
    (nativeBytes saved).map encode = bytesOf saved.val := by
  simp only [nativeBytes,bytesOf,List.map_map]
  exact List.map_congr_left (fun byte _ => byte_representation byte)

/-- The loaded version is connected to the same returned vector by first
using the computed write payload in the history premise. A1768-byte list is
never manufactured as an independent checkpoint observation. Native wrapper
source/heap interpretation is still needed to instantiate this local law. -/
theorem returned_committed {F : Type} (heap : Heap F) (account token owner : Nat)
    (saved : alloc.vec.Vec U8) (loaded : Bytes)
    (empty : heap.guards = []) (zero : heap.counter (heap.accounts account).1 = 0)
    (destinationSize : (heap.payload (heap.accounts account).1).descriptor.length = 1768)
    (savedSize : saved.val.length = 1768)
    (version : S2X.CheckpointVersionBinding
      (payloadBytes encode ((writeBracket heap account token owner (source (nativeBytes saved))).payload
        (heap.accounts account).1) 1768) loaded) :
    loaded = bytesOf saved.val ∧
    Nonempty (S2W_AuthenticatedInputs.CheckpointVersionBinding (bytesOf saved.val) loaded) := by
  have size : (nativeBytes saved).length = 1768 := by
    simpa only [nativeBytes,List.length_map] using savedSize
  obtain ⟨same,rebound⟩ := committed_version encode heap account token owner (nativeBytes saved)
    loaded empty zero destinationSize size version
  rw [vector_representation] at same rebound
  exact ⟨same,rebound⟩

#print axioms byte_representation
#print axioms vector_representation
#print axioms returned_committed
end AspisR1.S2W_ReturnedCheckpoint

S2W_AccountObservations.text:
import S2W_CommittedCheckpoint

/-! Full account observations computed from heap states. Inaccessible indices
have no native data cell and retain the ambient record. The lens includes all
Account fields, including lamports/rentEpoch absent from OwnedAccount.
This is an interpreted wrapper theorem, not a native-wrapper extraction law. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.S2W_AccountObservations
open S2Trust S2W_TrustedStd S2W_WrapperLaws S2W_EntryWriteHistory
open AspisV8R19.DuplexFrames

def observe {F : Type} (encode : UInt8 → AspisV8R19.DuplexFrames.Byte)
    (metadata : F → Nat → S2LeadInterface.Account) (n : Nat) (s : Heap F)
    (a : Nat) : S2LeadInterface.Account :=
  if a < n then
    {metadata s.ambient a with data := (payloadBytes encode (s.payload (s.accounts a).1)
      (s.payload (s.accounts a).1).descriptor.length)}
  else metadata s.ambient a

/-- Snapshot's actual shared acquire/drop bracket changes no account record.
The copy/allocation source port remains separate, as in the imported SDK law. -/
theorem snapshot_frame {F : Type} (encode : UInt8 → AspisV8R19.DuplexFrames.Byte)
    (metadata : F → Nat → S2LeadInterface.Account) (n : Nat) (s : Heap F)
    (keys : Nat → List UInt8) (a token owner : Nat)
    (runtime : AdapterRw.RuntimeEntrypointAdmission s keys n) (within : a < n) :
    observe encode metadata n (AdapterRw.Snapshots.sharedBracket s a token owner) =
      observe encode metadata n s := by
  rw [AdapterRw.Snapshots.entry_bracket_restores runtime within token owner]

/-- Lift the checked wrapper's single-cell frame to full account records.
Alias exclusion is explicit, not inferred merely from unequal slot numbers. -/
theorem write_frame {F : Type} (encode : UInt8 → AspisV8R19.DuplexFrames.Byte)
    (metadata : F → Nat → S2LeadInterface.Account) (n : Nat) (s : Heap F)
    (writer token owner : Nat) (src : Payload)
    (empty : s.guards = []) (zero : s.counter (s.accounts writer).1 = 0)
    (a : Nat) (disjoint : a < n → (s.accounts a).1 ≠ (s.accounts writer).1) :
    observe encode metadata n (writeBracket s writer token owner src) a =
      observe encode metadata n s a := by
  rw [write_bracket s writer token owner src empty zero]
  by_cases within : a < n
  · simp [observe,within,copyHeap,put,disjoint within]
  · simp [observe,within,copyHeap]

/-- The written account's entire metadata record is unchanged. No account
post-state or metadata equation is a premise. -/
theorem write_metadata {F : Type} (encode : UInt8 → AspisV8R19.DuplexFrames.Byte)
    (metadata : F → Nat → S2LeadInterface.Account) (n : Nat) (s : Heap F)
    (writer token owner : Nat) (src : Payload)
    (empty : s.guards = []) (zero : s.counter (s.accounts writer).1 = 0) :
    {observe encode metadata n (writeBracket s writer token owner src) writer with
      data := (observe encode metadata n s writer).data} = observe encode metadata n s writer := by
  rw [write_bracket s writer token owner src empty zero]
  by_cases within : writer < n
  · simp [observe,within,copyHeap]
  · simp [observe,within,copyHeap]

/-- Runtime key/cell admission discharges the local alias-exclusion condition
for an accessible account with a different key from the checkpoint account. -/
theorem admitted_write_frame {F : Type} (encode : UInt8 → AspisV8R19.DuplexFrames.Byte)
    (metadata : F → Nat → S2LeadInterface.Account) (n : Nat) (s : Heap F)
    (keys : Nat → List UInt8) (writer token owner : Nat) (src : Payload)
    (runtime : AdapterRw.RuntimeEntrypointAdmission s keys n) (writerWithin : writer < n)
    (a : Nat) (different : a < n → keys a ≠ keys writer) :
    observe encode metadata n (writeBracket s writer token owner src) a =
      observe encode metadata n s a := by
  apply write_frame encode metadata n s writer token owner src runtime.freshGuards
    (runtime.counterZero writer writerWithin) a
  intro within
  exact AdapterRw.distinct_keys_distinct_cells runtime within writerWithin (different within)

#print axioms snapshot_frame
#print axioms write_frame
#print axioms write_metadata
#print axioms admitted_write_frame
end AspisR1.S2W_AccountObservations

S2W_D189Interpretation.text:
import S2W_AccountObservations
import S2W_Trace

/-! D189: instantiate the existing SDK interpretation, rather than requesting
an additional whole-wrapper equivalence hypothesis. The account observations
read native SDK cells; metadata is the runtime ambient account record.
The owned evaluator cannot receive or return an account-state capability. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.S2W_D189Interpretation
open S2Trust S2W_EntryWriteHistory S2W_AccountObservations
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result S2W_Trace

/-- Native data observation through the actual typed SDK library carrier.
The ambient parameter is the runtime metadata interpretation, not an inferred
OwnedAccount projection (which omits lamports and rentEpoch). -/
def nativeObserve {W F : Type} (L : Library W F)
    (encode : UInt8 → AspisV8R19.DuplexFrames.Byte)
    (metadata : F → Nat → S2LeadInterface.Account) (n : Nat)
    (w : W) (ambient : F) (a : Nat) : S2LeadInterface.Account :=
  if a < n then
    {metadata ambient a with data := (payloadBytes encode
      (L.cellPayload w (L.accountData w a))
      (L.cellPayload w (L.accountData w a)).descriptor.length)}
  else metadata ambient a

/-- The native AccountInfo/heap association is obtained from exactly the
approved account_data_cell and cell_payload fields. It is not a caller
postcondition, source equality, or new native-binding assumption. -/
theorem native_observation {W F : Type} (L : Library W F)
    (sdk : S2TrustedSdkBorrow L)
    (encode : UInt8 → AspisV8R19.DuplexFrames.Byte)
    (metadata : F → Nat → S2LeadInterface.Account) (n : Nat)
    (w : W) (s : Heap F) (related : L.related w s) (valid : Valid s) :
    nativeObserve L encode metadata n w s.ambient = observe encode metadata n s := by
  funext a
  have cell := (sdk.account_data_cell w s related valid a a).1
  have payload := sdk.cell_payload w s related valid (s.accounts a).1
  simp only [nativeObserve,observe,cell,payload]

/-- The native counter/guard ledger is the SAME heap's ledger. -/
theorem native_counter {W F : Type} (L : Library W F)
    (sdk : S2TrustedSdkBorrow L) (w : W) (s : Heap F)
    (related : L.related w s) (valid : Valid s) (c : Nat) :
    L.cellCounter w c = s.counter c ∧ ∀ t, L.liveGuard w t = lookup s t :=
  sdk.cell_counter w s related valid c

/-- State extension of the extracted typed evaluator. Its calls have exactly
the extracted owned signatures; no AccountInfo or Heap argument is passed to
invoke. Account state is threaded separately from owned values and call log. -/
def runOwned {F A : Type} (ops : AdapterRw.Ops) :
    Code A → Log → Heap F → Result (A × Log × Heap F)
  | .done a, log, s => ok (a,log,s)
  | .step r k, log, s => thenResult r (fun b => runOwned ops (k b) log s)
  | .call call k, log, s => thenResult (invoke ops call) (fun b =>
      runOwned ops (k b) (log ++ [.returned call b]) s)

/-- Signature-derived frame, by induction over EVERY extracted call and
continuation, including errors/divergence. No child-frame premise is used. -/
theorem owned_account_frame {F A : Type} (ops : AdapterRw.Ops)
    (code : Code A) (log : Log) (s : Heap F) :
    runOwned ops code log s =
      thenResult (S2W_Trace.run ops code log) (fun answer => ok (answer.1,answer.2,s)) := by
  induction code generalizing log with
  | done a => rfl
  | step r k ih =>
    cases r with
    | ok b => exact ih b log
    | fail e => rfl
    | div => rfl
  | call call k ih =>
    cases invoked : invoke ops call with
    | ok b => simpa only [runOwned,S2W_Trace.run,invoked,thenResult] using ih b (log ++ [.returned call b])
    | fail e => simp only [runOwned,S2W_Trace.run,invoked,thenResult]
    | div => simp only [runOwned,S2W_Trace.run,invoked,thenResult]

/-- Specialization to the actual accepted owned execution, with the account
heap unchanged and the exact typed log retained. -/
theorem accepted_owned_frame {F A : Type} (ops : AdapterRw.Ops)
    (code : Code A) (before after : Log) (value : A) (s : Heap F)
    (accepted : S2W_Trace.run ops code before = ok (value,after)) :
    runOwned ops code before s = ok (value,after,s) := by
  rw [owned_account_frame,accepted]; rfl

#print axioms native_observation
#print axioms native_counter
#print axioms owned_account_frame
#print axioms accepted_owned_frame
end AspisR1.S2W_D189Interpretation

import S2W_SnapshotFacts
import S2X_SnapshotWrite

/-! Connect the exact extracted snapshot to the owned accepted caller.
The one remaining snapshot-return equality is a wrapper observation, not an
OwnedSnapshotShape/entrySize assumption and not yet reified from a native run. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.S2W.SnapshotJoin
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1.AdapterRw
open AspisR1.S2W.Snapshot

/-- Invert the actual owned data accessor, including the opaque clone failure
paths. A deferred snapshot error cannot masquerade as successful data. -/
theorem data_success (ownedOps : AdapterRw.Ops) (account : OwnedAccount)
    (data : Slice U8)
    (success : AdapterRw.r1_pool_adapter.owned.OwnedAccount.data ownedOps account =
      ok (.Ok data)) :
    ∃ bytes : alloc.vec.Vec U8,
      account.bytes = .Ok bytes ∧ alloc.vec.Vec.deref bytes = data := by
  cases stored : account.bytes with
  | Ok bytes =>
    refine ⟨bytes,rfl,?_⟩
    simpa only [AdapterRw.r1_pool_adapter.owned.OwnedAccount.data,stored,
      Result.ok.injEq,core.result.Result.Ok.injEq] using success
  | Err error =>
    unfold AdapterRw.r1_pool_adapter.owned.OwnedAccount.data at success
    rw [stored] at success
    exact False.elim (Cuts.error_bind_ne_ok (ownedOps.op35 error) data success)

/-- The previous snapshot-shape hypothesis is derived from the snapshot
execution itself, on the same returned account and successful data read. -/
theorem snapshot_shape (C : Carriers) (ops : Ops C) (ownedOps : AdapterRw.Ops)
    (account : AccountInfo C) (length1 length2 : Usize)
    (out : OwnedAccount) (data : Slice U8)
    (returned : snapshot C ops account length1 length2 = ok out)
    (read : AdapterRw.r1_pool_adapter.owned.OwnedAccount.data ownedOps out =
      ok (.Ok data)) : Nonempty (AspisR1.S2X.OwnedSnapshotShape ownedOps out) := by
  obtain ⟨bytes,stored,_⟩ := data_success ownedOps out data read
  exact ⟨⟨bytes,stored,(successful_shape C ops account length1 length2 out bytes
    returned stored).1⟩⟩

/-- The SAME checkpoint returned by accepted owned TX1 has1768 bytes, with
neither OwnedSnapshotShape nor entrySize supplied as a premise. Native entry
indexing/SDK interpretation still must supply the displayed snapshot return. -/
theorem accepted_checkpoint_length (C : Carriers) (ops : Ops C)
    (ownedOps : AdapterRw.Ops) (nativeCheckpoint : AccountInfo C)
    (program : AdapterRw.solana_pubkey.Pubkey) (accounts : Slice Cuts.Account)
    (data : Slice U8) (checkpoint : alloc.vec.Vec U8)
    (accepted : AdapterRw.r1_pool_adapter.owned.stage1_owned ownedOps program accounts data =
      ok (.Ok checkpoint))
    (at2 : Cuts.Account)
    (selected : Slice.index_usize accounts 2#usize = ok at2)
    (returned : snapshot C ops nativeCheckpoint 1768#usize 1768#usize = ok at2) :
    checkpoint.val.length = 1768 := by
  obtain ⟨account,bytes,index,read,sameLength⟩ :=
    Cuts.stage1_checkpoint_length ownedOps program accounts data checkpoint accepted
  have same : account = at2 := Result.ok.inj (index.symm.trans selected)
  subst account
  obtain ⟨copied,stored,view⟩ := data_success ownedOps at2 bytes read
  have size := checkpoint_entry_size C ops nativeCheckpoint at2 copied returned stored
  have length := congrArg UScalar.val sameLength
  rw [← view] at length
  exact length.trans size

#print axioms data_success
#print axioms snapshot_shape
#print axioms accepted_checkpoint_length
end AspisR1.S2W.SnapshotJoin

S2W_D189Entry.text:
import S2W_D189Interpretation
import S2W_EntryPrivileges
import S2W_ReturnedCheckpoint
import S2W_SnapshotJoin

/-! Runtime account interpretation used to instantiate D189. Finite Rust byte
buffers and full metadata are inputs. Snapshots are COMPUTED from these inputs,
with the same admitted-length/deferred-error branches as the Kani-checked
native wrapper. No owned snapshot shape, post-state, or alias-frame is input. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.S2W_D189Entry
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result S2Trust
open S2W_ReturnedCheckpoint S2W_CommittedCheckpoint S2W_EntryWriteHistory
open MultiproofConeCanonical AspisV8R19.DuplexFrames
abbrev Owned := AdapterRw.Cuts.Account

structure Record where
  owned : Owned
  lamports : Nat
  rentEpoch : Nat

structure Entry where
  handles : Nat → Nat × Nat
  records : Nat → Record
  buffers : Nat → Slice U8
  base : Nat → Nat
  provenance : Nat → Nat

def Entry.payload (e : Entry) (c : Nat) : Payload :=
  {(source (nativeBytes (e.buffers c))) with
    descriptor := ⟨e.base c,(e.buffers c).val.length,e.provenance c⟩}

def Entry.heap (e : Entry) : Heap (Nat → Record) where
  accounts := e.handles
  ownerLive := fun _ => true
  allocated := fun _ => true
  payload := e.payload
  counter := fun _ => 0
  external := fun _ => 0
  guards := []
  ambient := e.records

/-- Full native metadata is interpreted by cell identity. Duplicate runtime
handles denote the same account record/privileges. Allocator and syscall
state are outside this account-only projection, as permitted by D189/P2-P4. -/
def Entry.metadata (e : Entry) (records : Nat → Record) (a : Nat) : S2LeadInterface.Account :=
  let r := records (e.handles a).1
  {key := bytesOf r.owned.key.val,owner := bytesOf r.owned.owner.val,
   lamports := r.lamports,data := [],signer := r.owned.is_signer,
   writable := r.owned.is_writable,executable := r.owned.executable,rentEpoch := r.rentEpoch}

/-- Selected-cell snapshot contract, lifted to the complete retained buffer.
Under runtime admission borrow cannot fail; malformed length is deferred.
Vec allocation failure is transaction abort, outside the accepted branch. -/
def Entry.snapshot (e : Entry) (a len1 len2 : Nat) : Owned :=
  let bytes := e.buffers (e.handles a).1
  {(e.records (e.handles a).1).owned with
    length := .Ok (Slice.len bytes)
    bytes := if bytes.val.length = len1 ∨ bytes.val.length = len2 then .Ok bytes
      else .Err AdapterRw.solana_program_error.ProgramError.InvalidAccountData}

def Entry.first (e : Entry) : S2W_ExtractionBoundary.Accounts :=
  ⟨[e.snapshot 0 58295 58295,e.snapshot 1 1880 1880,e.snapshot 2 1768 1768],by simp only [List.length_cons,List.length_nil]; scalar_tac⟩

def Entry.second (e : Entry) (sizes : Nat → Nat × Nat) : S2W_ExtractionBoundary.Accounts :=
  ⟨List.ofFn (fun i : Fin 7 => e.snapshot i.val (sizes i.val).1 (sizes i.val).2),by simp only [List.length_ofFn]; scalar_tac⟩

 theorem first_index (e : Entry) :
    Slice.index_usize e.first 0#usize = ok (e.snapshot 0 58295 58295) ∧
    Slice.index_usize e.first 1#usize = ok (e.snapshot 1 1880 1880) ∧
    Slice.index_usize e.first 2#usize = ok (e.snapshot 2 1768 1768) := by
  exact ⟨rfl,rfl,rfl⟩

/-- Alias exclusion follows from the ACTUAL source privilege guards, without
assuming distinct keys, distinct data cells, or the accountFrame conclusion. -/
theorem first_disjoint (e : Entry) (ops : AdapterRw.Ops)
    (program : S2W_ExtractionBoundary.Program) (data : Slice U8) (saved : alloc.vec.Vec U8)
    (accepted : AdapterRw.r1_pool_adapter.owned.stage1_owned ops program e.first data = ok (.Ok saved)) :
    ∀ a, a < 3 → a ≠ 2 → (e.heap.accounts a).1 ≠ (e.heap.accounts 2).1 := by
  obtain ⟨pa,pu,ca,ip,iu,ic,rp,ru,rc⟩ :=
    S2W_EntryPrivileges.accepted_privileges ops program e.first data saved accepted
  have eqp := Result.ok.inj (ip.symm.trans (first_index e).1)
  have equ := Result.ok.inj (iu.symm.trans (first_index e).2.1)
  have eqc := Result.ok.inj (ic.symm.trans (first_index e).2.2)
  subst pa; subst pu; subst ca
  change (e.records (e.handles 0).1).owned.is_writable = false at rp
  change (e.records (e.handles 1).1).owned.is_writable = false at ru
  change (e.records (e.handles 2).1).owned.is_writable = true at rc
  intro a within different same
  change (e.handles a).1 = (e.handles 2).1 at same
  have cases : a = 0 ∨ a = 1 := by omega
  rcases cases with h | h
  · subst a; rw [same,rc] at rp; cases rp
  · subst a; rw [same,rc] at ru; cases ru

/-- The destination length is derived from the SAME accepted checkpoint read
and the native wrapper's deferred-length branch; no entrySize premise. -/
theorem checkpoint_size (e : Entry) (ops : AdapterRw.Ops)
    (program : S2W_ExtractionBoundary.Program) (data : Slice U8) (saved : alloc.vec.Vec U8)
    (accepted : AdapterRw.r1_pool_adapter.owned.stage1_owned ops program e.first data = ok (.Ok saved)) :
    (e.heap.payload (e.heap.accounts 2).1).descriptor.length = 1768 := by
  obtain ⟨ca,bytes,ic,read,_⟩ := AdapterRw.Cuts.stage1_checkpoint_length ops program e.first data saved accepted
  have eqc := Result.ok.inj (ic.symm.trans (first_index e).2.2)
  subst ca
  obtain ⟨copied,stored,_⟩ := S2W.SnapshotJoin.data_success ops (e.snapshot 2 1768 1768) bytes read
  change (if (e.buffers (e.handles 2).1).val.length = 1768 ∨
      (e.buffers (e.handles 2).1).val.length = 1768 then core.result.Result.Ok (e.buffers (e.handles 2).1)
      else core.result.Result.Err AdapterRw.solana_program_error.ProgramError.InvalidAccountData) =
      core.result.Result.Ok copied at stored
  split at stored
  · rename_i size
    exact size.elim id id
  · cases stored

/-- Canonical byte representation of the original native account buffer. -/
theorem payload_bytes (e : Entry) (c : Nat) :
    payloadBytes encode (e.payload c) (e.payload c).descriptor.length = bytesOf (e.buffers c).val := by
  change payloadBytes encode (source (nativeBytes (e.buffers c))) (e.buffers c).val.length = _
  have size : (nativeBytes (e.buffers c)).length = (e.buffers c).val.length := by
    simp only [nativeBytes,List.length_map]
  rw [← size,source_bytes,vector_representation]

/-- The SDK data descriptor exposes exactly the original finite native buffer,
not a post-execution read of an allegedly identical allocation. -/
theorem native_buffer {W : Type} (e : Entry) (L : Library W (Nat → Record))
    (sdk : S2TrustedSdkBorrow L) (w : W) (related : L.related w e.heap)
    (valid : Valid e.heap) (a : Nat) :
    payloadBytes encode (L.cellPayload w (L.accountData w a))
      (L.cellPayload w (L.accountData w a)).descriptor.length =
      bytesOf (e.buffers (e.handles a).1).val := by
  rw [(sdk.account_data_cell w e.heap related valid a a).1,
    sdk.cell_payload w e.heap related valid (e.heap.accounts a).1]
  exact payload_bytes e (e.handles a).1

import S2W_D189Entry

/-! D189 interpretation of the two non-extracted wrappers. Kani004 (real SDK
write) and union019 (all selected-coordinate wrappers) check this source
control flow. The primitive SDK/std interpretations retain their named trust
boundaries. Native acceptance below is the wrapper execution, not a supplied
post-account equality. Allocation errors abort and cannot return inner Ok. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.S2W_D189Wrappers
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result S2Trust S2W_D189Entry
open S2W_TrustedStd S2W_WrapperLaws S2W_ReturnedCheckpoint S2W_CommittedCheckpoint

/-- Runtime allocator interface on its private region. P2-P4 admit this
separation from account cells. Allocation or cleanup failure aborts; the
caller proves nothing about an aborted transaction's committed accounts. -/
structure Allocator (A : Type) where
  allocate : A → Nat → Result A
  cleanup : A → Result A

def reserve {A : Type} (allocator : Allocator A) : List Nat → A → Result A
  | [], state => ok state
  | size :: sizes, state => S2W_Trace.thenResult (allocator.allocate state size)
      (fun next => reserve allocator sizes next)

def admittedSizes (e : Entry) (count : Nat) (sizes : Nat → Nat × Nat) : List Nat :=
  (List.range count).filterMap (fun a =>
    let len := (e.buffers (e.handles a).1).val.length
    if len = (sizes a).1 ∨ len = (sizes a).2 then some len else none)

def firstSizes : Nat → Nat × Nat
  | 0 => (58295,58295) | 1 => (1880,1880) | _ => (1768,1768)

def secondSizes : Nat → Nat × Nat
  | 0 => (58295,58295) | 1 => (384,384) | 2 => (192,192)
  | 3 => (768,768) | 4 => (128,256) | 5 => (192,320) | _ => (1768,1768)

/-- Account-only state extension of std Vec allocation/cleanup. to_vec's
complete byte law is Snapshot.to_vec_identity; the allocator does not receive
an AccountInfo or a heap capability. This is the runtime allocator premise's
interpretation, not a claim that allocator state remains unchanged. -/
def allocateSnapshots {A : Type} (allocator : Allocator A) (e : Entry)
    (count : Nat) (sizes : Nat → Nat × Nat) (state : A) :
    Result (A × Heap (Nat → Record)) :=
  S2W_Trace.thenResult (reserve allocator (admittedSizes e count sizes) state)
    (fun next => ok (next,e.heap))

 theorem allocation_frame {A : Type} (allocator : Allocator A) (e : Entry)
    (count : Nat) (sizes : Nat → Nat × Nat) (state next : A) (heap : Heap (Nat → Record))
    (returned : allocateSnapshots allocator e count sizes state = ok (next,heap)) :
    heap = e.heap := by
  unfold allocateSnapshots at returned
  cases allocated : reserve allocator (admittedSizes e count sizes) state with
  | fail error => simp [allocated,S2W_Trace.thenResult] at returned
  | div => simp [allocated,S2W_Trace.thenResult] at returned
  | ok value =>
    simp only [allocated,S2W_Trace.thenResult] at returned
    exact (congrArg Prod.snd (Result.ok.inj returned)).symm

/-- The native first wrapper: same snapshot bounds, owned call, one mutable
borrow/copy/drop, then owned-Vec cleanup. SDK acquisition/drop use the approved
interpretation; bulk copy is the separately named TrustedStd primitive. -/
def first {A : Type} (native : S2W_ExtractionBoundary.First)
    (copy : Heap (Nat → Record) → Nat → Payload → Outcome (Nat → Record))
    (allocator : Allocator A) (e : Entry) (program : S2W_ExtractionBoundary.Program)
    (data : Slice U8) (state : A) :
    Result (core.result.Result (alloc.vec.Vec U8 × Heap (Nat → Record) × A) AdapterRw.Cuts.PE) := do
  let allocated ← reserve allocator (admittedSizes e 3 firstSizes) state
  let result ← native program e.first data
  match result with
  | .Err error => ok (.Err error)
  | .Ok saved =>
    match copy (acquire e.heap (e.heap.accounts 2).1 0 0 .exclusive) (e.heap.accounts 2).1
        (source (nativeBytes saved)) with
    | .panic => .fail .assertionFailure
    | .returned written =>
      let cleaned ← allocator.cleanup allocated
      ok (.Ok (saved,release written (exclusiveGuard e.heap 2 0 0),cleaned))

def second {A : Type} (native : S2W_ExtractionBoundary.Second)
    (allocator : Allocator A) (e : Entry) (program : S2W_ExtractionBoundary.Program)
    (data : Slice U8) (slot : S2W_ExtractionBoundary.Slot) (state : A) :
    Result (core.result.Result (Heap (Nat → Record) × A) AdapterRw.Cuts.PE) := do
  let allocated ← reserve allocator (admittedSizes e 7 secondSizes) state
  let result ← native program (e.second secondSizes) data slot
  match result with
  | .Err error => ok (.Err error)
  | .Ok () =>
    let cleaned ← allocator.cleanup allocated
    ok (.Ok (e.heap,cleaned))

/-- Invert wrapper acceptance. The actual returned heap is derived from the
single trusted std copy; no savedAtWrite or after-account observation supplied. -/
theorem first_accepted {A : Type} (native : S2W_ExtractionBoundary.First)
    (copy : Heap (Nat → Record) → Nat → Payload → Outcome (Nat → Record))
    (std : TrustedStd copy) (allocator : Allocator A) (e : Entry)
    (program : S2W_ExtractionBoundary.Program) (data : Slice U8) (state final : A)
    (saved : alloc.vec.Vec U8) (after : Heap (Nat → Record))
    (accepted : first native copy allocator e program data state = ok (.Ok (saved,after,final))) :
    native program e.first data = ok (.Ok saved) ∧
    after = writeBracket e.heap 2 0 0 (source (nativeBytes saved)) := by
  unfold first at accepted
  obtain ⟨allocated,_,rest⟩ := AdapterRw.Cuts.bind_success _ _ _ accepted
  obtain ⟨result,called,rest⟩ := AdapterRw.Cuts.bind_success _ _ _ rest
  cases result with
  | Err error => cases rest
  | Ok value =>
    dsimp only at rest
    cases copied : copy (acquire e.heap (e.heap.accounts 2).1 0 0 .exclusive)
        (e.heap.accounts 2).1 (source (nativeBytes value)) with
    | panic => simp only [copied] at rest; cases rest
    | returned written =>
      rw [copied] at rest
      obtain ⟨cleaned,_,returned⟩ := AdapterRw.Cuts.bind_success _ _ _ rest
      have equal := core.result.Result.Ok.inj (Result.ok.inj returned)
      have same : value = saved := congrArg Prod.fst equal
      subst value
      refine ⟨called,?_⟩
      have actual := std.slice_copy_from_slice
        (acquire e.heap (e.heap.accounts 2).1 0 0 .exclusive) (e.heap.accounts 2).1
        (source (nativeBytes saved))
      rw [copied] at actual
      unfold specification at actual
      split at actual
      · have w := Outcome.returned.inj actual
        rw [w] at equal
        exact (congrArg (fun pair => pair.2.1) equal).symm
      · cases actual

 theorem second_accepted {A : Type} (native : S2W_ExtractionBoundary.Second)
    (allocator : Allocator A) (e : Entry) (program : S2W_ExtractionBoundary.Program)
    (data : Slice U8) (slot : S2W_ExtractionBoundary.Slot) (state final : A)
    (after : Heap (Nat → Record))
    (accepted : second native allocator e program data slot state = ok (.Ok (after,final))) :
    native program (e.second secondSizes) data slot = ok (.Ok ()) ∧ after = e.heap := by
  unfold second at accepted
  obtain ⟨allocated,_,rest⟩ := AdapterRw.Cuts.bind_success _ _ _ accepted
  obtain ⟨result,called,rest⟩ := AdapterRw.Cuts.bind_success _ _ _ rest
  cases result with
  | Err error => cases rest
  | Ok value =>
    obtain ⟨cleaned,_,returned⟩ := AdapterRw.Cuts.bind_success _ _ _ rest
    have equal := core.result.Result.Ok.inj (Result.ok.inj returned)
    exact ⟨called,(congrArg Prod.fst equal).symm⟩

#print axioms allocation_frame
#print axioms first_accepted
#print axioms second_accepted
end AspisR1.S2W_D189Wrappers
end

import S2W_TwoFieldAudit

/-! The exact already emitted three-line SolanaDigest wrapper and to_bytes
body, with only the opaque hashv callee parameterized. The current production
method is byte-identical to the retained extracted source fragment. See
S2W_digest_inventory.py and digest-source-reuse.json; no S4 candidate edited.
This does not reattribute the old cone theorem or assume NativeBinding. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.S2W_DigestExtraction
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open S2W_ExtractionBoundary
open AspisV8R19.DuplexFrames AspisV8R19.SourceDuplexStep
abbrev Parts := S2Z.Oracle.Parts
abbrev Digest := S2Z.Oracle.Digest

/-- Exact emitted Hash::to_bytes body; Hash is emitted as Array U8 32. -/
def toBytes (self : Digest) : Result Digest := do
  ok self

/-- Exact emitted source digest body after the recorded single external-callee
substitution and nominal carrier reuse. Neither success nor totality assumed. -/
def digest (hashv : Parts → Result Digest) (self : AdapterRw.SolanaDigest)
    (parts : Parts) : Result Digest := do
  let h ← hashv parts
  toBytes h

/-- Source wrapper contributes no extra value or termination premise. -/
theorem digest_eq_hashv (hashv : Parts → Result Digest) (self : AdapterRw.SolanaDigest)
    (parts : Parts) : digest hashv self parts = hashv parts := by
  unfold digest toBytes
  cases hashv parts <;> rfl

/-- D188 extraction trust refers to the EXTRACTED source wrapper here, rather
than treating its old opaque op43 as already proved to be hashv. These are
source-function interpretation equalities, not any caller field or conclusion.
The code identity/reused emission audit is explicit in the evidence packet. -/
structure AeneasExtraction (ops : AdapterRw.Ops) (native1 : First) (native2 : Second)
    (hashv : Parts → Result Digest) : Prop where
  stage1 : ∀ program accounts data,
    native1 program accounts data = AdapterRw.r1_pool_adapter.owned.stage1_owned ops program accounts data
  stage2 : ∀ program accounts data slot,
    native2 program accounts data slot = AdapterRw.r1_pool_adapter.owned.stage2_owned ops program accounts data slot
  digestSource : ∀ self parts, ops.op43 self parts = digest hashv self parts

/-- NativeBinding is now a theorem from the source wrapper extraction. -/
theorem native_binding (ops : AdapterRw.Ops) (native1 : First) (native2 : Second)
    (hashv : Parts → Result Digest) (extraction : AeneasExtraction ops native1 native2 hashv) :
    S2Z.Oracle.NativeBinding ops hashv := by
  intro self parts
  exact (extraction.digestSource self parts).trans (digest_eq_hashv hashv self parts)

/-- Transport into earlier helpers; their digest equality is derived, not a
second trusted premise. All final uses should construct it through this map. -/
def sourceBoundary (ops : AdapterRw.Ops) (native1 : First) (native2 : Second)
    (hashv : Parts → Result Digest) (extraction : AeneasExtraction ops native1 native2 hashv) :
    S2W_ExtractionBoundary.AeneasExtraction ops native1 native2 hashv :=
  ⟨extraction.stage1,extraction.stage2,native_binding ops native1 native2 hashv extraction⟩

/-- No extra NativeBinding or total oracle premise at the native source port. -/
theorem native_oracle (ops : AdapterRw.Ops) (native1 : First) (native2 : Second)
    (hashv : Parts → Result Digest) (extraction : AeneasExtraction ops native1 native2 hashv)
    (sha256 H : Bytes → State) (p1 : S2W_ExtractionBoundary.P1 sha256 H)
    (runtime : S2W_ExtractionBoundary.RuntimeSyscall hashv sha256) :
    CheckpointBytes5Inputs.Oracle (S2Z.Oracle.leadDigest ops) () H :=
  S2W_ExtractionBoundary.native_oracle ops native1 native2 hashv
    (sourceBoundary ops native1 native2 hashv extraction) sha256 H p1 runtime

#print axioms digest_eq_hashv
#print axioms native_binding
#print axioms native_oracle
#print AeneasExtraction
end AspisR1.S2W_DigestExtraction
end

S2W_D189Consolidation.text:
import S2W_D189Wrappers
import S2W_ScheduledConsolidation

/-! Full Required14 for every accepted two-transaction wrapper execution in
the D189 SDK/std/runtime interpretation. Primitive interpretation and owned
extraction are the existing trust items; no caller cut or account-frame
conclusion occurs in a premise. Child ports remain separately named. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.S2W_D189Consolidation
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result S2Trust S2LeadInterface
open S2W_D189Entry S2W_D189Wrappers S2W_TrustedStd S2W_WrapperLaws
open S2W_ReturnedCheckpoint S2W_EntryWriteHistory S2W_CommittedCheckpoint
open S2W_NativeConsolidation S2W_AuthenticatedInputs S2W_InputSchedule
open S2W_ExpandedChildren S2W_TraceSplice MultiproofConeCanonical
open AspisV8R19.DuplexFrames AspisV8R19.SourceDuplexStep

/-- Existing runtime entry premise instantiated with the native metadata/cell
interpretation. These are initial-state eligibility facts, universally local;
no accepted execution or postcondition occurs in either field. -/
structure RuntimeEntrypointAdmission {W : Type} (L : Library W (Nat → Record))
    (e : Entry) (w : W) (n : Nat) : Prop where
  entry : AdapterRw.RuntimeEntrypointAdmission e.heap
    (fun a => (e.records (e.handles a).1).owned.key.val.map nativeByte) n
  related : L.related w e.heap

def before (e1 e2 : Entry) (site : Site) : Nat → Account :=
  if site.rank ≤ 3 then S2W_AccountObservations.observe encode e1.metadata 3 e1.heap
  else S2W_AccountObservations.observe encode e2.metadata 7 e2.heap

def after (e1 e2 : Entry) (post1 : Heap (Nat → Record)) (site : Site) : Nat → Account :=
  if site = .tx1 then S2W_AccountObservations.observe encode e1.metadata 3 post1
  else before e1 e2 site

/-- Compute the full native account frame from the accepted wrapper heap,
source-derived privileges, and runtime alias interpretation. -/
theorem wrapper_frames (e1 e2 : Entry) (ops : AdapterRw.Ops)
    (program : S2W_ExtractionBoundary.Program) (data : Slice U8) (saved : alloc.vec.Vec U8)
    (accepted : AdapterRw.r1_pool_adapter.owned.stage1_owned ops program e1.first data = ok (.Ok saved))
    (post1 : Heap (Nat → Record))
    (written : post1 = writeBracket e1.heap 2 0 0 (source (nativeBytes saved))) :
    (∀ site a, dataWrite site a = false → after e1 e2 post1 site a = before e1 e2 site a) ∧
    {after e1 e2 post1 .tx1 2 with data := (before e1 e2 .tx1 2).data} = before e1 e2 .tx1 2 := by
  have disjoint := first_disjoint e1 ops program data saved accepted
  constructor
  · intro site a notWritten
    by_cases tx1 : site = .tx1
    · subst site
      have other : a ≠ 2 := by
        intro same; subst a; simp [dataWrite] at notWritten
      change S2W_AccountObservations.observe encode e1.metadata 3 post1 a =
        S2W_AccountObservations.observe encode e1.metadata 3 e1.heap a
      rw [written]
      exact S2W_AccountObservations.write_frame encode e1.metadata 3 e1.heap 2 0 0
        (source (nativeBytes saved)) rfl rfl a (fun within => disjoint a within other)
    · simp only [after,if_neg tx1]
  · change {S2W_AccountObservations.observe encode e1.metadata 3 post1 2 with
        data := (S2W_AccountObservations.observe encode e1.metadata 3 e1.heap 2).data} = _
    rw [written]
    exact S2W_AccountObservations.write_metadata encode e1.metadata 3 e1.heap 2 0 0
      (source (nativeBytes saved)) rfl rfl

/-- Every accepted native wrapper pair has one expanded execution-indexed
observation satisfying ALL fourteen fields. The history premise is indexed
to its actual returned post-write payload. Input proof/public retention uses
writer/reader authentication plus P2Prime; FullForestAcceptedRoundtrip is
therefore not needed by this stronger authentication route.

Accepted executions are equations for the composed wrappers themselves.
SourceCuts, savedAtWrite, sameStoredProof, NativeBinding, entrySize, range/site
cuts, and the two account-frame fields are all outputs, never hypotheses. -/
theorem accepted_run {W A E : Type}
    (L : Library W (Nat → Record)) (sdk : S2TrustedSdkBorrow L)
    (copy : Heap (Nat → Record) → Nat → Payload → Outcome (Nat → Record))
    (std : TrustedStd copy) (allocator : Allocator A)
    (e1 e2 : Entry) (w1 w2 : W)
    (admission1 : RuntimeEntrypointAdmission L e1 w1 3)
    (admission2 : RuntimeEntrypointAdmission L e2 w2 7)
    (ops : AdapterRw.Ops) (native1 : S2W_ExtractionBoundary.First) (native2 : S2W_ExtractionBoundary.Second)
    (hashv : S2Z.Oracle.Parts → Result S2Z.Oracle.Digest)
    (extraction : S2W_DigestExtraction.AeneasExtraction ops native1 native2 hashv)
    (sha256 H : Bytes → State) (p1 : S2W_ExtractionBoundary.P1 sha256 H)
    (syscall : S2W_ExtractionBoundary.RuntimeSyscall hashv sha256)
    (program : S2W_ExtractionBoundary.Program) (data1 data2 : Slice U8)
    (slot : S2W_ExtractionBoundary.Slot) (state1 state2 final1 final2 : A)
    (saved : alloc.vec.Vec U8) (post1 post2 : Heap (Nat → Record))
    (accepted1 : S2W_D189Wrappers.first native1 copy allocator e1 program data1 state1 =
      ok (.Ok (saved,post1,final1)))
    (accepted2 : S2W_D189Wrappers.second native2 allocator e2 program data2 slot state2 =
      ok (.Ok (post2,final2)))
    (port : ChildConeJoin E ops) (firstMarks : FirstMarks port) (secondMarks : SecondMarks port) :
    ∃ f s outer pre middle fs ss,
      SourceCuts ops e1.first (e2.second secondSizes) saved f s ∧
      S2W_ExpandedTrace.runExpanded ops (children port)
        (S2W_Observation.two ops program e1.first data1 (e2.second secondSizes) data2 slot) [] =
        ok (.Ok saved,S2W_ExpandedTrace.full (children port) outer) ∧
      S2W_D189Interpretation.runOwned ops
        (S2W_Observation.two ops program e1.first data1 (e2.second secondSizes) data2 slot) [] e1.heap =
        ok (.Ok saved,outer,e1.heap) ∧
      projected port outer = S2W_SiteSchedule.timeline pre middle fs ss ∧
      post2 = e2.heap ∧
      before e1 e2 .tx1 = S2W_D189Interpretation.nativeObserve L encode e1.metadata 3 w1 e1.heap.ambient ∧
      before e1 e2 .tx2 = S2W_D189Interpretation.nativeObserve L encode e2.metadata 7 w2 e2.heap.ambient ∧
      ∀ (decode : HeaderDecode) (nodes : Nat → Nat → Slice U8) (y1 : Slice U8),
      CheckpointWriterConeJoin ops decode H f.semantic f.pub f.proof f.split →
      CheckpointReaderConeJoin ops decode H s.pub s.proof s.checkpoint →
      S2X.CheckpointVersionBinding
        (payloadBytes encode (post1.payload (e1.heap.accounts 2).1) 1768) (bytesOf s.checkpoint.val) →
      P2Prime H f.proof f.pub s.proof s.pub →
      S2W_ChildJoins.FirstEntryVerifierConeJoin f.proof →
      S2W_ChildJoins.MultiproofConeJoin f.proof s.proof nodes →
      S2W_ChildJoins.S8StageConeJoin f.proof y1 →
      ∃ parsed,
        S2W_LeadInterface.S2CallerFacts
          (observation f s saved nodes y1 pre middle fs ss (before e1 e2) (after e1 e2 post1))
          (S2Z.Oracle.leadDigest ops) () H (bytesOf f.proof.val) (bytesOf f.pub.val)
          (bytesOf saved.val) parsed ∧
        (∀ site, (observation f s saved nodes y1 pre middle fs ss (before e1 e2) (after e1 e2 post1)).reached site ↔
          S2W_SiteSchedule.Event.site site ∈ projected port outer) := by
  obtain ⟨owned1,written⟩ := first_accepted native1 copy std allocator e1 program data1 state1 final1 saved post1 accepted1
  obtain ⟨owned2,unchanged⟩ := second_accepted native2 allocator e2 program data2 slot state2 final2 post2 accepted2
  let boundary := S2W_DigestExtraction.sourceBoundary ops native1 native2 hashv extraction
  have source1 : AdapterRw.r1_pool_adapter.owned.stage1_owned ops program e1.first data1 = ok (.Ok saved) :=
    (boundary.stage1 program e1.first data1).symm.trans owned1
  obtain ⟨f,s,outer,pre,middle,fs,ss,cuts,execution,expanded,layout,projectedInputs⟩ :=
    S2W_ScheduledConsolidation.accepted_run ops native1 native2 hashv extraction sha256 H p1 syscall
      program e1.first (e2.second secondSizes) data1 data2 slot saved owned1 owned2 port firstMarks secondMarks
  refine ⟨f,s,outer,pre,middle,fs,ss,cuts,expanded,
    S2W_D189Interpretation.accepted_owned_frame ops _ [] outer (core.result.Result.Ok saved : core.result.Result (alloc.vec.Vec U8) AdapterRw.Cuts.PE) e1.heap execution,
    layout,unchanged,?_,?_,?_⟩
  · exact (S2W_D189Interpretation.native_observation L sdk encode e1.metadata 3 w1 e1.heap
      admission1.related admission1.entry.valid).symm
  · exact (S2W_D189Interpretation.native_observation L sdk encode e2.metadata 7 w2 e2.heap
      admission2.related admission2.entry.valid).symm
  intro decode nodes y1 writer reader history p2prime entry multiproof scan
  have destinationSize := checkpoint_size e1 ops program data1 saved source1
  have versionAtWrite : S2X.CheckpointVersionBinding
      (payloadBytes encode ((writeBracket e1.heap 2 0 0 (source (nativeBytes saved))).payload
        (e1.heap.accounts 2).1) 1768) (bytesOf s.checkpoint.val) := by
    rw [← written]; exact history
  obtain ⟨_,⟨version⟩⟩ := returned_committed e1.heap 2 0 0 saved (bytesOf s.checkpoint.val)
    rfl rfl destinationSize (writer.size saved cuts.first) versionAtWrite
  obtain ⟨parsed,partialFacts,sites⟩ := projectedInputs decode nodes y1 writer reader version p2prime
    entry multiproof scan (before e1 e2) (after e1 e2 post1)
  have frames := wrapper_frames e1 e2 ops program data1 saved source1 post1 written
  refine ⟨parsed,?_,sites⟩
  apply (S2W_TwoFieldAudit.full_fields_iff _ ops H _ _ _ parsed partialFacts).2
  exact ⟨fun site _ a allowed => frames.1 site a allowed,fun _ => frames.2⟩

#print axioms wrapper_frames
