import Std

/-! Route B primitive library semantics. No production runtime instance is supplied.
Cell/token/location names below are abstract identities, never integer addresses.
The interpretation relation must bind them to typed Rust values and provenance.
The concrete machine is a consistency witness, not SDK certification. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.S2Trust

/-- SBF has 64-bit isize. The negative range is retained for external borrows,
including split external mutable guards; this interface never creates splits. -/
def maxCounter : Int := 9223372036854775807
def minCounter : Int := -9223372036854775808

structure Descriptor where
  base : Nat
  length : Nat
  provenance : Nat
  deriving DecidableEq

/-- Exact typed slice descriptor and current contents. Empty slices are allowed.
Only indices below length are accessible. The map is not a fabricated buffer. -/
structure Payload where
  descriptor : Descriptor
  contents : Nat → UInt8

inductive Kind where
  | shared | exclusive
  deriving DecidableEq

structure Guard where
  token : Nat
  cell : Nat
  owner : Nat
  kind : Kind
  descriptor : Descriptor
  deriving DecidableEq

/-- ambient includes all metadata, Rc counts, lamports, allocator and oracle state.
accounts maps handles to data/lamports cell identities; aliases are permitted.
external records already-live borrows outside the tracked local guard set. -/
structure Heap (Ambient : Type) where
  accounts : Nat → Nat × Nat
  ownerLive : Nat → Bool
  allocated : Nat → Bool
  payload : Nat → Payload
  counter : Nat → Int
  external : Nat → Int
  guards : List Guard
  ambient : Ambient

def lookup {F : Type} (s : Heap F) (t : Nat) : Option Guard :=
  s.guards.find? (fun g => g.token == t)

def count {F : Type} (s : Heap F) (c : Nat) (k : Kind) : Int :=
  ((s.guards.filter (fun g => g.cell == c && g.kind == k)).length : Int)

/-- Runtime admission is separate. In particular distinct keys do not imply
cell disjointness. External shared guards and pre-existing conflicts survive.
The external negative case has no tracked guards; no split/leak is introduced. -/
def Valid {F : Type} (s : Heap F) : Prop :=
  s.guards.Pairwise (fun g h => g.token ≠ h.token ∧ g.owner ≠ h.owner) ∧
  (∀ c, minCounter ≤ s.counter c ∧ s.counter c ≤ maxCounter ∧
    s.counter c = s.external c + count s c .shared - count s c .exclusive ∧
    (count s c .exclusive > 0 → s.external c = 0 ∧ count s c .shared = 0 ∧
      count s c .exclusive = 1) ∧
    (s.external c < 0 → count s c .shared = 0 ∧ count s c .exclusive = 0)) ∧
  (∀ g, g ∈ s.guards → s.allocated g.cell = true ∧
    g.descriptor = (s.payload g.cell).descriptor) ∧
  (∀ a, s.ownerLive a = true →
    (s.accounts a).1 ≠ (s.accounts a).2 ∧ s.allocated (s.accounts a).1 = true)

inductive Op where
  | shared (account token owner : Nat)
  | exclusive (account token owner : Nat)
  | deref (token : Nat)
  | write (token index : Nat) (value : UInt8)
  | move (token destination : Nat)
  | drop (token : Nat)
  | errorMoveDrop

/-- The Result discriminant is explicit. Err owns no token. A move acts on the
single token owner whether inside a Result, argument, return or local slot. -/
inductive Reply where
  | guard (token : Nat)
  | borrowFailed
  | payload (value : Payload)
  | unit

def put {A : Type} (f : Nat → A) (c : Nat) (v : A) : Nat → A :=
  fun d => if d = c then v else f d

def acquire {F : Type} (s : Heap F) (c t o : Nat) (k : Kind) : Heap F :=
  {s with counter := put s.counter c (if k = .shared then s.counter c + 1 else -1)
          guards := ⟨t,c,o,k,(s.payload c).descriptor⟩ :: s.guards}

def release {F : Type} (s : Heap F) (g : Guard) : Heap F :=
  {s with counter := put s.counter g.cell
            (if g.kind = .shared then s.counter g.cell - 1 else 0)
          guards := s.guards.filter (fun h => h.token != g.token)}

def relocate {F : Type} (s : Heap F) (t o : Nat) : Heap F :=
  {s with guards := s.guards.map (fun g => if g.token = t then {g with owner := o} else g)}

def writeAt {F : Type} (s : Heap F) (g : Guard) (i : Nat) (v : UInt8) : Heap F :=
  {s with payload := put s.payload g.cell ({(s.payload g.cell) with contents := put (s.payload g.cell).contents i v})}

def Fresh {F : Type} (s : Heap F) (t o : Nat) : Prop :=
  lookup s t = none ∧ ∀ g, g ∈ s.guards → g.owner ≠ o

/-- Legitimate library operations only: no stale owner, invalid token, free,
realloc, split, clone, leak, lamport borrow, CPI or concurrency operation. -/
def Enabled {F : Type} (s : Heap F) : Op → Prop
  | .shared a t o | .exclusive a t o => s.ownerLive a = true ∧ Fresh s t o
  | .deref t | .drop t => ∃ g, lookup s t = some g
  | .write t i _ => ∃ g, lookup s t = some g ∧ g.kind = .exclusive ∧
      i < (s.payload g.cell).descriptor.length
  | .move t o => (∃ g, lookup s t = some g) ∧ ∀ g, g ∈ s.guards → g.owner ≠ o
  | .errorMoveDrop => True

/-- Executable mathematical specification. Out-of-domain operations are not
licensed by the trust item. Their unit replies are not SDK error semantics. -/
def run {F : Type} (s : Heap F) : Op → Heap F × Reply
  | .shared a t o =>
      let c := (s.accounts a).1
      if 0 ≤ s.counter c ∧ s.counter c < maxCounter then
        (acquire s c t o .shared, .guard t) else (s, .borrowFailed)
  | .exclusive a t o =>
      let c := (s.accounts a).1
      if s.counter c = 0 then (acquire s c t o .exclusive, .guard t)
      else (s, .borrowFailed)
  | .deref t => match lookup s t with
      | some g => (s, .payload (s.payload g.cell))
      | none => (s, .unit)
  | .write t i v => match lookup s t with
      | some g => if g.kind = .exclusive ∧ i < (s.payload g.cell).descriptor.length
          then (writeAt s g i v, .unit) else (s, .unit)
      | none => (s, .unit)
  | .move t o => (relocate s t o, .guard t)
  | .drop t => match lookup s t with
      | some g => (release s g, .unit)
      | none => (s, .unit)
  | .errorMoveDrop => (s, .borrowFailed)

/-- A typed Rust interpretation supplies this carrier and relation. Neither
an instance for production nor relatedness of its initial heap is proved here.
The observations include BOTH RefCell/value dereferences and actual allocation
identity, not raw usize equalities. accountData denotes Rc dereference. -/
structure Library (W F : Type) where
  related : W → Heap F → Prop
  accountData : W → Nat → Nat
  accountLamports : W → Nat → Nat
  cellPayload : W → Nat → Payload
  cellCounter : W → Nat → Int
  liveGuard : W → Nat → Option Guard
  allocated : W → Nat → Bool
  run : W → Op → W × Reply

def Matches {W F : Type} (L : Library W F) (w : W) (op : Op)
    (expected : Heap F × Reply) : Prop :=
  ∃ w', L.run w op = (w', expected.2) ∧ L.related w' expected.1

/-- TRUST ITEM: pinned Solana AccountInfo 2.3.0 plus production SBF core RefCell
semantics, exactly the fifteen route-B fields. Every fact ranges over arbitrary
valid related local states, WITHOUT adapter acceptance. This is additional
library trust, not a proof of SDK internals or a caller refinement. See
../evidence/s2-trust-20261023/production-pins.json for pins and P6 limitations. -/
structure S2TrustedSdkBorrow {W F : Type} (L : Library W F) : Prop where
  account_data_cell : ∀ w s, L.related w s → Valid s → ∀ a b,
    L.accountData w a = (s.accounts a).1 ∧
    L.accountLamports w a = (s.accounts a).2 ∧
    ((s.accounts a).1 = (s.accounts b).1 → L.accountData w a = L.accountData w b) ∧
    (s.ownerLive a = true → L.accountData w a ≠ L.accountLamports w a)
  cell_payload : ∀ w s, L.related w s → Valid s → ∀ c,
    L.cellPayload w c = s.payload c
  cell_counter : ∀ w s, L.related w s → Valid s → ∀ c,
    L.cellCounter w c = s.counter c ∧ ∀ t, L.liveGuard w t = lookup s t
  shared_ok : ∀ w s a t o, L.related w s → Valid s → Enabled s (.shared a t o) →
    0 ≤ s.counter (s.accounts a).1 → s.counter (s.accounts a).1 < maxCounter →
    Matches L w (.shared a t o) (acquire s (s.accounts a).1 t o .shared, .guard t)
  shared_err : ∀ w s a t o, L.related w s → Valid s → Enabled s (.shared a t o) →
    (s.counter (s.accounts a).1 < 0 ∨ s.counter (s.accounts a).1 = maxCounter) →
    Matches L w (.shared a t o) (s, .borrowFailed)
  exclusive_ok : ∀ w s a t o, L.related w s → Valid s → Enabled s (.exclusive a t o) →
    s.counter (s.accounts a).1 = 0 →
    Matches L w (.exclusive a t o) (acquire s (s.accounts a).1 t o .exclusive, .guard t)
  exclusive_err : ∀ w s a t o, L.related w s → Valid s → Enabled s (.exclusive a t o) →
    s.counter (s.accounts a).1 ≠ 0 → Matches L w (.exclusive a t o) (s, .borrowFailed)
  shared_deref : ∀ w s t g, L.related w s → Valid s → lookup s t = some g →
    g.kind = .shared → Matches L w (.deref t) (s, .payload (s.payload g.cell))
  exclusive_deref : ∀ w s t g, L.related w s → Valid s → lookup s t = some g →
    g.kind = .exclusive →
    Matches L w (.deref t) (s, .payload (s.payload g.cell)) ∧
    ∀ i v, i < (s.payload g.cell).descriptor.length →
      Matches L w (.write t i v) (writeAt s g i v, .unit)
  guard_move : ∀ w s t o, L.related w s → Valid s → Enabled s (.move t o) →
    Matches L w (.move t o) (relocate s t o, .guard t)
  shared_drop : ∀ w s t g, L.related w s → Valid s → lookup s t = some g →
    g.kind = .shared → 0 < s.counter g.cell →
    Matches L w (.drop t) (release s g, .unit)
  exclusive_drop : ∀ w s t g, L.related w s → Valid s → lookup s t = some g →
    g.kind = .exclusive → s.counter g.cell = -1 →
    Matches L w (.drop t) (release s g, .unit)
  error_move_drop : ∀ w s, L.related w s → Valid s →
    Matches L w .errorMoveDrop (s, .borrowFailed)
  borrow_frame : ∀ w s op, L.related w s → Valid s → Enabled s op →
    Matches L w op (run s op)
  guard_liveness : ∀ w s t g, L.related w s → Valid s → lookup s t = some g →
    L.liveGuard w t = some g ∧ L.allocated w g.cell = true ∧
    (L.cellPayload w g.cell).descriptor = g.descriptor

/-- Identity interpretation: a nonempty concrete mathematical model, deliberately
NOT a relation to Rust memory. No claim of certification follows from it. -/
def model (F : Type) : Library (Heap F) F where
  related := Eq
  accountData := fun s a => (s.accounts a).1
  accountLamports := fun s a => (s.accounts a).2
  cellPayload := Heap.payload
  cellCounter := Heap.counter
  liveGuard := lookup
  allocated := Heap.allocated
  run := run

private theorem model_matches {F : Type} (s : Heap F) (op : Op) :
    Matches (model F) s op (run s op) := ⟨(run s op).1, rfl, rfl⟩

/-- All fifteen fields are jointly satisfiable, for arbitrary ambient state.
Universality is over all valid model states, not only the schedules below. -/
theorem model_satisfies (F : Type) : S2TrustedSdkBorrow (model F) where
  account_data_cell := by
    intro w s h hv a b
    cases h
    exact ⟨rfl, rfl, fun h => h, fun h => (hv.2.2.2 a h).1⟩
  cell_payload := by intro w s h _ c; cases h; rfl
  cell_counter := by intro w s h _ c; cases h; exact ⟨rfl, fun _ => rfl⟩
  shared_ok := by
    intro w s a t o h _ _ hn hm
    cases h
    simpa only [run, if_pos (And.intro hn hm)] using model_matches w (.shared a t o)
  shared_err := by
    intro w s a t o h _ _ hn
    cases h
    have no : ¬ (0 ≤ w.counter (w.accounts a).1 ∧ w.counter (w.accounts a).1 < maxCounter) := by omega
    simpa only [run, if_neg no] using model_matches w (.shared a t o)
  exclusive_ok := by
    intro w s a t o h _ _ hn
    cases h
    simpa only [run, if_pos hn] using model_matches w (.exclusive a t o)
  exclusive_err := by
    intro w s a t o h _ _ hn
    cases h
    simpa only [run, if_neg hn] using model_matches w (.exclusive a t o)
  shared_deref := by
    intro w s t g h _ hg _
    cases h
    simpa only [run, hg] using model_matches w (.deref t)
  exclusive_deref := by
    intro w s t g h _ hg hk
    cases h
    constructor
    · simpa only [run, hg] using model_matches w (.deref t)
    · intro i v hi
      simpa only [run, hg, if_pos (And.intro hk hi)] using model_matches w (.write t i v)
  guard_move := by intro w s t o h _ _; cases h; exact model_matches w (.move t o)
  shared_drop := by
    intro w s t g h _ hg _ _
    cases h
    simpa only [run, hg] using model_matches w (.drop t)
  exclusive_drop := by
    intro w s t g h _ hg _ _
    cases h
    simpa only [run, hg] using model_matches w (.drop t)
  error_move_drop := by intro w s h _; cases h; exact model_matches w .errorMoveDrop
  borrow_frame := by intro w s op h _ _; cases h; exact model_matches w op
  guard_liveness := by
    intro w s t g h hv hg
    cases h
    have mem : g ∈ w.guards := List.mem_of_find?_eq_some hg
    exact ⟨hg, (hv.2.2.1 g mem).1, (hv.2.2.1 g mem).2.symm⟩

#print axioms model_matches
#print axioms model_satisfies
end AspisR1.S2Trust

import S2TrustedSdkBorrow

/-! D157 / continuation-2 authorization: one pure slice primitive. A source
slice is a retained value, not an invented alias of the destination allocation.
The carrier includes the entire ambient state, so the field licenses no
allocator, SDK, syscall, helper or caller effect. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.S2W_TrustedStd
open S2Trust

inductive Outcome (F : Type) where
  | returned (heap : Heap F)
  | panic

/-- Copy exactly the accessible destination range; preserve descriptor and
inaccessible contents. The source is evaluated before the destination write. -/
def copied (dst src : Payload) : Payload :=
  {dst with contents := fun i => if i < dst.descriptor.length then src.contents i else dst.contents i}

def copyHeap {F : Type} (s : Heap F) (dst : Nat) (src : Payload) : Heap F :=
  {s with payload := put s.payload dst (copied (s.payload dst) src)}

def specification {F : Type} (s : Heap F) (dst : Nat) (src : Payload) : Outcome F :=
  if (s.payload dst).descriptor.length = src.descriptor.length
  then .returned (copyHeap s dst src) else .panic

/-- Exactly one added trust field. `copy` is the interpreted native
slice::copy_from_slice operation on valid exclusive dst/shared src slices.
Its domain excludes invalid Rust references; reference admission is the SDK /
runtime boundary, not an additional std behavior. Equal lengths copy; unequal
lengths panic; the only state change is destination contents. -/
structure TrustedStd {F : Type}
    (copy : Heap F → Nat → Payload → Outcome F) : Prop where
  slice_copy_from_slice : ∀ s dst src, copy s dst src = specification s dst src

/-- Consistency witness only; no production-library instance is asserted. -/
theorem specification_satisfies (F : Type) :
    TrustedStd (specification (F := F)) := ⟨fun _ _ _ => rfl⟩

/-- A proved per-cell contract composes by function extensionality. Outside
length is framed as well; no finite enumeration or concrete buffer reduction. -/
theorem cells_compose (dst src after : Payload)
    (descriptor : after.descriptor = dst.descriptor)
    (cells : ∀ i, after.contents i =
      if i < dst.descriptor.length then src.contents i else dst.contents i) :
    after = copied dst src := by
  cases after with
  | mk desc contents =>
    simp only at descriptor cells
    subst desc
    have same : contents = (copied dst src).contents := funext cells
    cases dst
    simp only [copied] at same ⊢
    cases same
    rfl

theorem accepted_copy {F : Type} (copy : Heap F → Nat → Payload → Outcome F)
    (std : TrustedStd copy) (s : Heap F) (dst : Nat) (src : Payload)
    (lengths : (s.payload dst).descriptor.length = src.descriptor.length) :
    copy s dst src = .returned (copyHeap s dst src) := by
  rw [std.slice_copy_from_slice, specification, if_pos lengths]

theorem mismatched_copy {F : Type} (copy : Heap F → Nat → Payload → Outcome F)
    (std : TrustedStd copy) (s : Heap F) (dst : Nat) (src : Payload)
    (lengths : (s.payload dst).descriptor.length ≠ src.descriptor.length) :
    copy s dst src = .panic := by
  rw [std.slice_copy_from_slice, specification, if_neg lengths]

/-- Full ambient/account/borrow/allocator frame plus every other payload. -/
theorem copy_frame {F : Type} (s : Heap F) (dst : Nat) (src : Payload) :
    (copyHeap s dst src).ambient = s.ambient ∧
    (copyHeap s dst src).accounts = s.accounts ∧
    (copyHeap s dst src).counter = s.counter ∧
    (copyHeap s dst src).external = s.external ∧
    (copyHeap s dst src).guards = s.guards ∧
    (copyHeap s dst src).allocated = s.allocated ∧
    (copyHeap s dst src).ownerLive = s.ownerLive ∧
    (∀ c, ((copyHeap s dst src).payload c).descriptor = (s.payload c).descriptor) ∧
    (∀ c, c ≠ dst → (copyHeap s dst src).payload c = s.payload c) := by
  refine ⟨rfl,rfl,rfl,rfl,rfl,rfl,rfl,?_,?_⟩
  · intro c
    by_cases h : c = dst <;> simp [copyHeap,put,copied,h]
  · intro c h
    simp [copyHeap,put,h]

#print axioms specification_satisfies
#print axioms cells_compose
#print axioms accepted_copy
#print axioms mismatched_copy
#print axioms copy_frame
end AspisR1.S2W_TrustedStd

import S2TrustedSdkBorrow

/-! D183 runtime-entry premise. This is independent of adapter acceptance.
Its SDK/runtime source check is runtime-source-check.json. It does not establish
allocator/CU admission, native interpretation, inter-transaction retention or ROM.
No existing SDK trust field is changed. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.AdapterRw
open S2Trust

structure RuntimeEntrypointAdmission {F : Type} (s : Heap F)
    (keys : Nat → List UInt8) (accountCount : Nat) : Prop where
  valid : Valid s
  freshGuards : s.guards = []
  noExternalBorrows : ∀ c, s.external c = 0
  liveAccount : ∀ a, a < accountCount → s.ownerLive a = true
  counterZero : ∀ a, a < accountCount → s.counter (s.accounts a).1 = 0
  sharedCellsOnlyEqualKeys : ∀ a b, a < accountCount → b < accountCount →
    (s.accounts a).1 = (s.accounts b).1 → keys a = keys b
  duplicateKeysShareCell : ∀ a b, a < accountCount → b < accountCount →
    keys a = keys b → (s.accounts a).1 = (s.accounts b).1

theorem distinct_keys_distinct_cells {F : Type} {s : Heap F}
    {keys : Nat → List UInt8} {n a b : Nat}
    (runtime : RuntimeEntrypointAdmission s keys n)
    (ha : a < n) (hb : b < n) (different : keys a ≠ keys b) :
    (s.accounts a).1 ≠ (s.accounts b).1 := by
  intro same
  exact different (runtime.sharedCellsOnlyEqualKeys a b ha hb same)

theorem entry_shared_available {F : Type} {s : Heap F}
    {keys : Nat → List UInt8} {n a t o : Nat}
    (runtime : RuntimeEntrypointAdmission s keys n) (ha : a < n) :
    (run s (.shared a t o)).2 = .guard t := by
  simp [run, runtime.counterZero a ha, maxCounter]

theorem entry_exclusive_available {F : Type} {s : Heap F}
    {keys : Nat → List UInt8} {n a t o : Nat}
    (runtime : RuntimeEntrypointAdmission s keys n) (ha : a < n) :
    (run s (.exclusive a t o)).2 = .guard t := by
  simp only [run, runtime.counterZero a ha, ↓reduceIte]

#print axioms distinct_keys_distinct_cells
#print axioms entry_shared_available
#print axioms entry_exclusive_available
end AspisR1.AdapterRw

import S2W_ExpandedTrace

/-! Named per-call child source executions. Their arguments/results are the
actual typed call occurrence; there is no caller-wide observation equality,
account frame, retained input equality, or schedule conclusion in the port. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.S2W_ExpandedChildren
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result S2W_Trace S2W_ExpandedTrace

structure ChildConeJoin (E : Type) (ops : AdapterRw.Ops) where
  execute : {A : Type} → Call A → Result (A × List (S2W_ExpandedTrace.Event E))
  erasure : ∀ {A : Type} (call : Call A),
    thenResult (execute call) (fun answer => ok answer.1) = invoke ops call

def events {E : Type} {ops : AdapterRw.Ops} (port : ChildConeJoin E ops) :
    S2W_Trace.Event → List (S2W_ExpandedTrace.Event E)
  | .returned call _ => match port.execute call with
    | .ok (_,log) => log
    | _ => []

def invocation {E : Type} : S2W_Trace.Event → List (S2W_ExpandedTrace.Event E)
  | .returned (.op10 _ _ _ _ _ _ _) _ => [.site .tx1]
  | .returned (.op11 _ _ _ _ _ _) _ => [.site .tx2]
  | _ => []

def children {E : Type} {ops : AdapterRw.Ops} (port : ChildConeJoin E ops)
    (event : S2W_Trace.Event) : List (S2W_ExpandedTrace.Event E) :=
  invocation event ++ events port event

/-- Actual successful source invocation determines BOTH result and internal
trace. Failed/diverging children cannot contribute an invented event list. -/
theorem returned_child {E A : Type} {ops : AdapterRw.Ops} (port : ChildConeJoin E ops)
    (call : Call A) (value : A) (valid : invoke ops call = ok value) :
    port.execute call = ok (value,events port (.returned call value)) := by
  have erased := (port.erasure call).trans valid
  cases execution : port.execute call with
  | fail error => simp only [execution,thenResult] at erased; cases erased
  | div => simp only [execution,thenResult] at erased; cases erased
  | ok answer =>
    simp only [execution,thenResult] at erased
    have same : answer.1 = value := Result.ok.inj erased
    simp only [events,execution]
    apply congrArg Result.ok
    exact Prod.ext same rfl

/-- Full events are now computed by substituting the source trace supplied
by the child cone at each outer-call occurrence. No free pre/middle lists or
independently selected replacement traces are arguments. -/
theorem accepted_native_children {E : Type}
    (ops : AdapterRw.Ops) (native1 : S2W_ExtractionBoundary.First)
    (native2 : S2W_ExtractionBoundary.Second)
    (hashv : S2Z.Oracle.Parts → Result S2Z.Oracle.Digest)
    (extraction : S2W_DigestExtraction.AeneasExtraction ops native1 native2 hashv)
    (program : S2W_ExtractionBoundary.Program)
    (accounts1 accounts2 : S2W_ExtractionBoundary.Accounts) (data1 data2 : Slice U8)
    (slot : S2W_ExtractionBoundary.Slot) (saved : alloc.vec.Vec U8)
    (accepted1 : native1 program accounts1 data1 = ok (.Ok saved))
    (accepted2 : native2 program accounts2 data2 slot = ok (.Ok ()))
    (port : ChildConeJoin E ops) :
    ∃ outer,
      run ops (S2W_Observation.two ops program accounts1 data1 accounts2 data2 slot) [] =
        ok (.Ok saved,outer) ∧
      runExpanded ops (children port)
        (S2W_Observation.two ops program accounts1 data1 accounts2 data2 slot) [] =
        ok (.Ok saved,full (children port) outer) ∧
      (∀ event ∈ outer, match event with
        | .returned call value =>
          port.execute call = ok (value,events port event)) := by
  obtain ⟨outer,execution,expanded,valid⟩ := accepted_native_flatMap ops native1 native2 hashv
    extraction program accounts1 accounts2 data1 data2 slot saved accepted1 accepted2 (children port)
  refine ⟨outer,execution,expanded,?_⟩
  intro event member
  cases event with
  | returned call value => exact returned_child port call value (valid _ member)

#print axioms returned_child
#print axioms accepted_native_children
#print ChildConeJoin
end AspisR1.S2W_ExpandedChildren

import S2W_ExpandedChildren
import S2W_FirstOccurrence

/-! Full native outer trace occurrence selection and child substitution.
Only local source-mark layouts are supplied by the two child cones. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.S2W_TraceSplice
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result S2W_Trace S2W_OuterOccurrences S2W_ExpandedTrace S2W_ExpandedChildren

theorem run_shift (ops : AdapterRw.Ops) {A : Type} (code : Code A) (headLog log : Log) :
    run ops code (headLog ++ log) = thenResult (run ops code log)
      (fun answer => ok (answer.1,headLog ++ answer.2)) := by
  induction code generalizing log with
  | done a => rfl
  | step r k ih =>
    cases r with
    | fail e => rfl
    | div => rfl
    | ok b => exact ih b log
  | call call k ih =>
    cases invoked : invoke ops call with
    | fail e => simp only [run,invoked,thenResult]
    | div => simp only [run,invoked,thenResult]
    | ok b =>
      simpa only [run,invoked,thenResult,List.append_assoc] using
        (ih b (log ++ [.returned call b]))

/-- Select a real occurrence from the log; headLog/suffix are computed by list
induction. The same typed event, including arguments and result, is retained. -/
theorem split_tag (log : Log) (tag : Bool) (rest : List Bool)
    (shape : tags log = tag :: rest) :
    ∃ pre event post, log = pre ++ event :: post ∧ tags pre = [] ∧
      mark event = some tag ∧ tags post = rest := by
  induction log with
  | nil => cases shape
  | cons event tail ih =>
    cases marked : mark event with
    | none =>
      have next : tags tail = tag :: rest := by simpa [tags,marked] using shape
      obtain ⟨pre,chosen,post,same,empty,first,last⟩ := ih next
      exact ⟨event :: pre,chosen,post,by simp [same],by simp [tags,marked] at empty ⊢; exact empty,first,last⟩
    | some value =>
      have next : value :: tags tail = tag :: rest := by simpa [tags,marked] using shape
      have same := List.cons.inj next
      exact ⟨[],event,tail,rfl,rfl,same.1 ▸ marked,same.2⟩

def project {E : Type} : S2W_ExpandedTrace.Event E → S2W_SiteSchedule.Event (Option E)
  | .outer _ => .source none
  | .child event => .source (some event)
  | .site site => .site site

def projected {E : Type} {ops : AdapterRw.Ops} (port : ChildConeJoin E ops) (log : Log) :=
  (full (children port) log).map project

/-- Independently named CHILD layout theorems about their own source runs.
No full caller schedule, account observation, input identity or caller field. -/
structure FirstMarks {E : Type} {ops : AdapterRw.Ops} (port : ChildConeJoin E ops) : Prop where
  source : ∀ event, mark event = some false → ∃ fs : S2W_SiteSchedule.FirstSegments (Option E),
    (events port event).map project = S2W_SiteSchedule.firstTrace fs
structure SecondMarks {E : Type} {ops : AdapterRw.Ops} (port : ChildConeJoin E ops) : Prop where
  source : ∀ event, mark event = some true → ∃ ss : S2W_SiteSchedule.SecondSegments (Option E),
    (events port event).map project = S2W_SiteSchedule.secondTrace ss

theorem invocation_first {E : Type} (event : S2W_Trace.Event) (marked : mark event = some false) :
    invocation (E := E) event = [.site .tx1] := by
  cases event with
  | returned call value => cases call <;> simp_all [mark,invocation]
theorem invocation_second {E : Type} (event : S2W_Trace.Event) (marked : mark event = some true) :
    invocation (E := E) event = [.site .tx2] := by
  cases event with
  | returned call value => cases call <;> simp_all [mark,invocation]

/-- The schedule is a projection of the expanded outer log, including the
post-TX2 outer suffix. Prefix/middle are DERIVED occurrence segments. -/
theorem expanded_schedule {E : Type} {ops : AdapterRw.Ops} (port : ChildConeJoin E ops)
    (first : FirstMarks port) (second : SecondMarks port) (outer : Log)
    (shape : tags outer = [false,true]) :
    ∃ pre middle fs ss,
      projected port outer = S2W_SiteSchedule.timeline pre middle fs ss := by
  obtain ⟨pre,e1,rest,same,_,m1,remaining⟩ := split_tag outer false [true] shape
  obtain ⟨middle,e2,post,same2,_,m2,_⟩ := split_tag rest true [] remaining
  obtain ⟨fs,layout1⟩ := first.source e1 m1
  obtain ⟨ss,layout2⟩ := second.source e2 m2
  let headLog := projected port pre ++ [.source none]
  let interval := projected port middle ++ [.source none]
  let ss' := {ss with afterFinish := ss.afterFinish ++ projected port post}
  refine ⟨headLog,interval,fs,ss',?_⟩
  have splice := S2W_ExpandedTrace.splice (children port) outer pre middle post e1 e2
    (by simp only [same,same2,List.append_assoc,List.cons_append,List.nil_append])
  unfold projected
  rw [splice]
  simp only [List.map_append,expand,children,invocation_first e1 m1,invocation_second e2 m2,
    List.map_cons,List.map_nil,project,layout1,layout2]
  simp only [headLog,interval,ss',S2W_SiteSchedule.timeline,S2W_SiteSchedule.secondTrace,
    projected,List.append_assoc,List.cons_append,List.nil_append]

#print axioms run_shift
#print axioms split_tag
#print axioms invocation_first
#print axioms invocation_second
#print axioms expanded_schedule
#print FirstMarks
#print SecondMarks
end AspisR1.S2W_TraceSplice

    cases h : invoke ops op with
    | fail e => simp only [run,thenResult,forget,erase,h,bind_tc_fail]
    | div => simp only [run,thenResult,forget,erase,h,bind_tc_div]
    | ok b => simpa only [run,thenResult,erase,h,bind_tc_ok] using ih b (log ++ [.returned op b])

    (before after : Log) (a : A) (success : run ops p before = ok (a,after)) :
    ∃ suffix, after = before ++ suffix := by
  induction p generalizing before after with
  | done b =>
    have eq := Result.ok.inj success
    exact ⟨[], by simpa using congrArg Prod.snd eq.symm⟩
  | step r k ih =>
    cases r with
    | fail e => cases success
    | div => cases success
    | ok b => exact ih b before after success
  | call op k ih =>
    cases h : invoke ops op with
    | fail e => simp only [run,thenResult,h]  at success; cases success
    | div => simp only [run,thenResult,h]  at success; cases success
    | ok b =>
      simp only [run,thenResult,h] at success
      obtain ⟨suffix,hs⟩ := ih b _ after success
      exact ⟨.returned op b :: suffix, by simpa only [List.append_assoc,List.singleton_append] using hs⟩

    erase ops (perform op) = invoke ops op := by
  cases h : invoke ops op <;> simp only [perform,erase,h,bind_tc_ok,bind_tc_fail,bind_tc_div]

theorem erase_lift (ops : AdapterRw.Ops) {A : Type} (r : Result A) :
    erase ops (liftResult r) = r := by cases r <;> rfl

theorem erase_bind (ops : AdapterRw.Ops) {A B : Type} (p : Code A) (k : A → Code B) :
    erase ops (p >>= k) = (do let a ← erase ops p; erase ops (k a)) := by
  induction p with
  | done a => rfl
  | step r c ih =>
    change (do let b ← r; erase ops (bind (c b) k)) = _
    have h : ∀ b, erase ops (bind (c b) k) =
      (do let a ← erase ops (c b); erase ops (k a)) := ih
    simp only [h,erase]
    cases r <;> rfl
  | call op c ih =>
    change (do let b ← invoke ops op; erase ops (bind (c b) k)) = _
    have h : ∀ b, erase ops (bind (c b) k) =
      (do let a ← erase ops (c b); erase ops (k a)) := ih
    simp only [h,erase]
    cases invoke ops op <;> rfl

import S2W_ExtractionBoundary

/-! Fixed-invocation child joins. Checkpoint authentication yields the two
hash comparisons; P2-prime yields the same proof/public buffers. In particular
neither sameStoredProof nor reconstructed-statement identity is a premise. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.S2W_AuthenticatedInputs
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1.AdapterRw MultiproofConeCanonical OraclePortCompactDraft
open AspisV8R19.DuplexFrames AspisV8R19.SourceDuplexStep
abbrev Header := State × State
abbrev HeaderDecode := Bytes → Option Header
abbrev Public := AdapterRw.LeadInputs.Public

/-- A checkpoint writer CHILD theorem, conditional on its actual successful
invocation. HeaderDecode is the concrete child header parser port, shared with
the reader. The fields concern its serialization, not retained caller sites,
account writes, cross-TX identity, S2 Inputs or S2CallerFacts. -/
structure CheckpointWriterConeJoin (ops : AdapterRw.Ops) (decode : HeaderDecode)
    (H : Bytes → State) (semantic : Public) (pub proof : Slice U8)
    (split : Usize) : Prop where
  header : ∀ checkpoint, AdapterRw.first_decoded ops semantic pub proof split = ok (.Ok checkpoint) →
    decode (bytesOf checkpoint.val) = some (H (bytesOf proof.val), H (bytesOf pub.val))
  size : ∀ checkpoint, AdapterRw.first_decoded ops semantic pub proof split = ok (.Ok checkpoint) →
    checkpoint.val.length = 1768

/-- Reader CHILD: successful verification checks the SAME parsed stored
header against its actual proof/public digest inputs. This is two digest
comparisons, not proof/public equality, account persistence or S2CallerFacts. -/
structure CheckpointReaderConeJoin (ops : AdapterRw.Ops) (decode : HeaderDecode)
    (H : Bytes → State) (pub proof checkpoint : Slice U8) : Prop where
  checkedHeader : ops.op11 (AdapterRw.SolanaDigest.Insts.Aspis_coreDigestDigest32 ops)
      pub proof checkpoint () none = ok (.Ok ()) →
    decode (bytesOf checkpoint.val) = some (H (bytesOf proof.val), H (bytesOf pub.val))

/-- Existing runtime P2-prime, indexed to THIS writer/reader pair. -/
structure P2Prime (H : Bytes → State) (proof1 pub1 proof2 pub2 : Slice U8) : Prop where
  binding : R9PoolRuntimeBinding.P2Prime H
    ⟨bytesOf proof1.val,bytesOf pub1.val⟩ ⟨bytesOf proof2.val,bytesOf pub2.val⟩

/-- Existing protected-version history, with no change of its domain. -/
structure CheckpointVersionBinding (saved loaded : Bytes) where
  history : S2X.CheckpointVersionBinding saved loaded

/-- Authentication composition. savedAtWrite and save/load byte identity are
not assumptions: saved is the actual returned vector; protected history binds
its committed version; reader/writer child headers yield digestMatches.
No full-forest reconstruction equality or universal ChildInputRetention. -/
theorem authenticated_inputs (ops : AdapterRw.Ops) (decode : HeaderDecode)
    (H : Bytes → State) (semantic : Public) (pub1 proof1 pub2 proof2 loaded : Slice U8)
    (split : Usize) (saved : alloc.vec.Vec U8)
    (first : AdapterRw.first_decoded ops semantic pub1 proof1 split = ok (.Ok saved))
    (second : ops.op11 (AdapterRw.SolanaDigest.Insts.Aspis_coreDigestDigest32 ops)
      pub2 proof2 loaded () none = ok (.Ok ()))
    (writer : CheckpointWriterConeJoin ops decode H semantic pub1 proof1 split)
    (reader : CheckpointReaderConeJoin ops decode H pub2 proof2 loaded)
    (version : CheckpointVersionBinding (bytesOf saved.val) (bytesOf loaded.val))
    (p2prime : P2Prime H proof1 pub1 proof2 pub2) :
    bytesOf proof2.val = bytesOf proof1.val ∧
    bytesOf pub2.val = bytesOf pub1.val ∧
    bytesOf loaded.val = bytesOf saved.val ∧
    (bytesOf saved.val).length = 1768 := by
  have persisted := S2X.checkpoint_persistence _ _ version.history
  have wrote := writer.header saved first
  have read := reader.checkedHeader second
  rw [persisted,wrote] at read
  have pairs := Option.some.inj read
  have matched : R9PoolRuntimeBinding.digestMatches H
      ⟨bytesOf proof1.val,bytesOf pub1.val⟩ ⟨bytesOf proof2.val,bytesOf pub2.val⟩ :=
    ⟨(congrArg Prod.fst pairs).symm,(congrArg Prod.snd pairs).symm⟩
  obtain ⟨proof,pub⟩ := p2prime.binding matched
  refine ⟨proof,pub,persisted,?_⟩
  simpa only [bytesOf,List.length_map] using writer.size saved first

/-- Consume the two authenticated byte identities on the SAME child geometry
ports. All four source-internal obligations are named per-child hypotheses;
there is no additional sameStoredProof or tx1ProofObservation premise. -/
theorem authenticated_geometry (ops : AdapterRw.Ops) (decode : HeaderDecode)
    (H : Bytes → State) (semantic : Public) (pub1 proof1 pub2 proof2 loaded y1 : Slice U8)
    (nodes : Nat → Nat → Slice U8) (split : Usize) (saved : alloc.vec.Vec U8)
    (first : AdapterRw.first_decoded ops semantic pub1 proof1 split = ok (.Ok saved))
    (second : ops.op11 (AdapterRw.SolanaDigest.Insts.Aspis_coreDigestDigest32 ops)
      pub2 proof2 loaded () none = ok (.Ok ()))
    (writer : CheckpointWriterConeJoin ops decode H semantic pub1 proof1 split)
    (reader : CheckpointReaderConeJoin ops decode H pub2 proof2 loaded)
    (version : CheckpointVersionBinding (bytesOf saved.val) (bytesOf loaded.val))
    (p2prime : P2Prime H proof1 pub1 proof2 pub2)
    (entry : S2W_ChildJoins.FirstEntryVerifierConeJoin proof1)
    (multiproof : S2W_ChildJoins.MultiproofConeJoin proof1 proof2 nodes)
    (scan : S2W_ChildJoins.S8StageConeJoin proof1 y1) :
    bytesOf proof2.val = bytesOf proof1.val ∧
    bytesOf pub2.val = bytesOf pub1.val ∧
    bytesOf loaded.val = bytesOf saved.val ∧
    (bytesOf saved.val).length = 1768 ∧
    ∃ tr p, OraclePortStoredParserC4.parseReached (bytesOf proof1.val) tr = some p ∧
      (∀ b k, b < 2 → k < 3 → bytesOf (nodes b k).val =
        slice p.wire (OraclePortSelectedDraft.slotStart (3*b+k))
          (32*OraclePortSelectedDraft.capacity (3*b+k))) ∧
      y1 = S8JoinFrozenScan.segment proof1 7031 464 ∧
      S8OwnedP6.check_values_owned y1 = ok (.Ok ()) := by
  obtain ⟨proof,pub,cp,size⟩ := authenticated_inputs ops decode H semantic pub1 proof1 pub2 proof2
    loaded split saved first second writer reader version p2prime
  exact ⟨proof,pub,cp,size,S2W_ChildJoins.internal_geometry proof1 proof2 y1 nodes
    entry multiproof scan proof⟩

import Lean
open Lean
-- Untrusted diagnostic IO only. No theorem imports or consumes this tool.
-- Clone names before releasing mmap regions; no Expr/Name escapes the module callback.
private def clone (s : String) : String := String.ofList s.toList
private def nameString (n : Name) : String := clone n.toString
private def parts (p : System.FilePath) : IO (Array (ModuleData × CompactedRegion)) := do
  let mut files := #[p]
  for suffix in [".server", ".private"] do
    let q : System.FilePath := p.toString ++ suffix
    if ← q.pathExists then files := files.push q
  readModuleDataParts files
private def findObject (roots : List String) (n : String) : IO System.FilePath := do
  for root in roots do
    let p : System.FilePath := root ++ "/" ++ n.replace "." "/" ++ ".olean"
    if ← p.pathExists then return p
  throw (IO.userError s!"Missing object {n}")
private def headerWork (data : ModuleData) : Array String := data.imports.map (fun i => nameString i.module)
private unsafe def readHeader (p : System.FilePath) : IO (Array String) := do
  let (data, region) ← readModuleData p
  let result := headerWork data
  -- Force creation of independent strings before dropping the compacted region.
  let size := result.foldl (fun n s => n+s.length) (0 : Nat)
  if size > 10000000 then throw (IO.userError "unreasonable header")
  region.free
  pure result
private unsafe def visit (roots : List String) (n : String)
    (seen : IO.Ref (Std.HashSet String)) (order : IO.Ref (Array (String × System.FilePath))) : IO Unit := do
  if (← seen.get).contains n then return
  seen.modify (·.insert n)
  let p ← findObject roots n
  for i in ← readHeader p do visit roots i seen order
  order.modify (·.push (n,p))
private def work (m : String) (data : ModuleData) (needed done : Std.HashSet String) :
    IO (Std.HashSet String × Std.HashSet String) := do
  let mut needed := needed
  let mut done := done
  let mut cs : Std.HashMap String ConstantInfo := {}
  for c in data.constants do cs := cs.insert (nameString c.name) c
  let mut pending := cs.toArray.toList.filterMap (fun (n,_) => if needed.contains n then some n else none)
  while !pending.isEmpty do
    let n := pending.head!
    pending := pending.tail!
    if done.contains n then continue
    done := done.insert n
    let some c := cs[n]? | throw (IO.userError s!"missing local {n}")
    let mut ds := c.type.getUsedConstants
    if let some v := c.value? (allowOpaque := true) then ds := ds ++ v.getUsedConstants
    if let .inductInfo v := c then ds := ds ++ v.ctors.toArray ++ v.all.toArray
    if let .recInfo v := c then
      ds := ds ++ v.all.toArray
      for rule in v.rules do ds := ds ++ rule.rhs.getUsedConstants
    let names := ds.map nameString
    IO.println ("EDGE " ++ (Json.arr #[toJson m,toJson n,toJson names]).compress)
    for d in names do
      needed := needed.insert d
      if cs.contains d && !done.contains d then pending := d :: pending
  if let some dest ← IO.getEnv "PORT18_SNAPSHOT" then
    let selected := data.constants.filter (fun c => done.contains (nameString c.name))
    unless selected.isEmpty do
      let p : System.FilePath := dest ++ "/" ++ m.replace "." "/" ++ ".olean"
      IO.FS.createDirAll p.parent.get!
      saveModuleData p m.toName { data with
        imports := #[]
        constants := selected
        constNames := selected.map (·.name)
        extraConstNames := #[]
        entries := #[] }
  pure (needed,done)
private unsafe def scan (m : String) (p : System.FilePath) (needed done : Std.HashSet String) :
    IO (Std.HashSet String × Std.HashSet String) := do
  let loaded ← parts p
  let some (data,_) := loaded.toList.getLast? | throw (IO.userError "empty")
  let result ← work m data needed done
  let regions := loaded.map (·.2)
  regions.reverse.forM CompactedRegion.free
  pure result
private unsafe def mainDiagnostic : IO Unit := do
  let some path ← IO.getEnv "LEAN_PATH" | throw (IO.userError "missing path")
  let roots := path.splitOn ":"

namespace AspisR1.S2W_AccountObservations
open S2Trust S2W_TrustedStd S2W_WrapperLaws S2W_EntryWriteHistory

def observe {F : Type} (encode : UInt8 → AspisV8R19.DuplexFrames.Byte)
    (metadata : F → Nat → S2LeadInterface.Account) (n : Nat) (s : Heap F)
    (a : Nat) : S2LeadInterface.Account :=
  if a < n then
    {metadata s.ambient a with data := (payloadBytes encode (s.payload (s.accounts a).1)
      (s.payload (s.accounts a).1).descriptor.length)}
  else metadata s.ambient a

/-- Snapshot's actual shared acquire/drop bracket changes no account record.
The copy/allocation source port remains separate, as in the imported SDK law. -/
theorem snapshot_frame {F : Type} (encode : UInt8 → AspisV8R19.DuplexFrames.Byte)
    (metadata : F → Nat → S2LeadInterface.Account) (n : Nat) (s : Heap F)
    (keys : Nat → List UInt8) (a token owner : Nat)
    (runtime : AdapterRw.RuntimeEntrypointAdmission s keys n) (within : a < n) :
    observe encode metadata n (AdapterRw.Snapshots.sharedBracket s a token owner) =
      observe encode metadata n s := by
  rw [AdapterRw.Snapshots.entry_bracket_restores runtime within token owner]

/-- Lift the checked wrapper's single-cell frame to full account records.
Alias exclusion is explicit, not inferred merely from unequal slot numbers. -/
theorem write_frame {F : Type} (encode : UInt8 → AspisV8R19.DuplexFrames.Byte)
    (metadata : F → Nat → S2LeadInterface.Account) (n : Nat) (s : Heap F)
    (writer token owner : Nat) (src : Payload)
    (empty : s.guards = []) (zero : s.counter (s.accounts writer).1 = 0)
    (a : Nat) (disjoint : a < n → (s.accounts a).1 ≠ (s.accounts writer).1) :
    observe encode metadata n (writeBracket s writer token owner src) a =
      observe encode metadata n s a := by
  rw [write_bracket s writer token owner src empty zero]
  by_cases within : a < n
  · simp [observe,within,copyHeap,put,disjoint within]
  · simp [observe,within,copyHeap]

/-- The written account's entire metadata record is unchanged. No account
post-state or metadata equation is a premise. -/
theorem write_metadata {F : Type} (encode : UInt8 → AspisV8R19.DuplexFrames.Byte)
    (metadata : F → Nat → S2LeadInterface.Account) (n : Nat) (s : Heap F)
    (writer token owner : Nat) (src : Payload)
    (empty : s.guards = []) (zero : s.counter (s.accounts writer).1 = 0) :
    {observe encode metadata n (writeBracket s writer token owner src) writer with
      data := (observe encode metadata n s writer).data} = observe encode metadata n s writer := by
  rw [write_bracket s writer token owner src empty zero]
  by_cases within : writer < n
  · simp [observe,within,copyHeap]
  · simp [observe,within,copyHeap]

/-- Runtime key/cell admission discharges the local alias-exclusion condition
for an accessible account with a different key from the checkpoint account. -/
theorem admitted_write_frame {F : Type} (encode : UInt8 → AspisV8R19.DuplexFrames.Byte)
    (metadata : F → Nat → S2LeadInterface.Account) (n : Nat) (s : Heap F)
    (keys : Nat → List UInt8) (writer token owner : Nat) (src : Payload)
    (runtime : AdapterRw.RuntimeEntrypointAdmission s keys n) (writerWithin : writer < n)
    (a : Nat) (different : a < n → keys a ≠ keys writer) :
    observe encode metadata n (writeBracket s writer token owner src) a =
      observe encode metadata n s a := by
  apply write_frame encode metadata n s writer token owner src runtime.freshGuards
    (runtime.counterZero writer writerWithin) a
  intro within
  exact AdapterRw.distinct_keys_distinct_cells runtime within writerWithin (different within)

/-- Native data observation through the actual typed SDK library carrier.
The ambient parameter is the runtime metadata interpretation, not an inferred
OwnedAccount projection (which omits lamports and rentEpoch). -/
def nativeObserve {W F : Type} (L : Library W F)
    (encode : UInt8 → AspisV8R19.DuplexFrames.Byte)
    (metadata : F → Nat → S2LeadInterface.Account) (n : Nat)
    (w : W) (ambient : F) (a : Nat) : S2LeadInterface.Account :=
  if a < n then
    {metadata ambient a with data := (payloadBytes encode
      (L.cellPayload w (L.accountData w a))
      (L.cellPayload w (L.accountData w a)).descriptor.length)}
  else metadata ambient a

/-- The native AccountInfo/heap association is obtained from exactly the
approved account_data_cell and cell_payload fields. It is not a caller
postcondition, source equality, or new native-binding assumption. -/
theorem native_observation {W F : Type} (L : Library W F)
    (sdk : S2TrustedSdkBorrow L)
    (encode : UInt8 → AspisV8R19.DuplexFrames.Byte)
    (metadata : F → Nat → S2LeadInterface.Account) (n : Nat)
    (w : W) (s : Heap F) (related : L.related w s) (valid : Valid s) :
    nativeObserve L encode metadata n w s.ambient = observe encode metadata n s := by
  funext a
  have cell := (sdk.account_data_cell w s related valid a a).1
  have payload := sdk.cell_payload w s related valid (s.accounts a).1
  simp only [nativeObserve,observe,cell,payload]

/-- The native counter/guard ledger is the SAME heap's ledger. -/
theorem native_counter {W F : Type} (L : Library W F)
    (sdk : S2TrustedSdkBorrow L) (w : W) (s : Heap F)
    (related : L.related w s) (valid : Valid s) (c : Nat) :
    L.cellCounter w c = s.counter c ∧ ∀ t, L.liveGuard w t = lookup s t :=
  sdk.cell_counter w s related valid c

/-- Invert the actual owned data accessor, including the opaque clone failure
paths. A deferred snapshot error cannot masquerade as successful data. -/
theorem data_success (ownedOps : AdapterRw.Ops) (account : OwnedAccount)
    (data : Slice U8)
    (success : AdapterRw.r1_pool_adapter.owned.OwnedAccount.data ownedOps account =
      ok (.Ok data)) :
    ∃ bytes : alloc.vec.Vec U8,
      account.bytes = .Ok bytes ∧ alloc.vec.Vec.deref bytes = data := by
  cases stored : account.bytes with
  | Ok bytes =>
    refine ⟨bytes,rfl,?_⟩
    simpa only [AdapterRw.r1_pool_adapter.owned.OwnedAccount.data,stored,
      Result.ok.injEq,core.result.Result.Ok.injEq] using success
  | Err error =>
    unfold AdapterRw.r1_pool_adapter.owned.OwnedAccount.data at success
    rw [stored] at success
    exact False.elim (Cuts.error_bind_ne_ok (ownedOps.op35 error) data success)

structure Record where
  owned : Owned
  lamports : Nat
  rentEpoch : Nat

structure Entry where
  handles : Nat → Nat × Nat
  records : Nat → Record
  buffers : Nat → Slice U8
  base : Nat → Nat
  provenance : Nat → Nat

def Entry.payload (e : Entry) (c : Nat) : Payload :=
  {(source (nativeBytes (e.buffers c))) with
    descriptor := ⟨e.base c,(e.buffers c).val.length,e.provenance c⟩}

def Entry.heap (e : Entry) : Heap (Nat → Record) where
  accounts := e.handles
  ownerLive := fun _ => true
  allocated := fun _ => true
  payload := e.payload
  counter := fun _ => 0
  external := fun _ => 0
  guards := []
  ambient := e.records

/-- Full native metadata is interpreted by cell identity. Duplicate runtime
handles denote the same account record/privileges. Allocator and syscall
state are outside this account-only projection, as permitted by D189/P2-P4. -/
def Entry.metadata (e : Entry) (records : Nat → Record) (a : Nat) : S2LeadInterface.Account :=
  let r := records (e.handles a).1
  {key := bytesOf r.owned.key.val,owner := bytesOf r.owned.owner.val,
   lamports := r.lamports,data := [],signer := r.owned.is_signer,
   writable := r.owned.is_writable,executable := r.owned.executable,rentEpoch := r.rentEpoch}

/-- Selected-cell snapshot contract, lifted to the complete retained buffer.
Under runtime admission borrow cannot fail; malformed length is deferred.
Vec allocation failure is transaction abort, outside the accepted branch. -/
def Entry.snapshot (e : Entry) (a len1 len2 : Nat) : Owned :=
  let bytes := e.buffers (e.handles a).1
  {(e.records (e.handles a).1).owned with
    length := .Ok (Slice.len bytes)
    bytes := if bytes.val.length = len1 ∨ bytes.val.length = len2 then .Ok bytes
      else .Err AdapterRw.solana_program_error.ProgramError.InvalidAccountData}

def Entry.first (e : Entry) : S2W_ExtractionBoundary.Accounts :=
  ⟨[e.snapshot 0 58295 58295,e.snapshot 1 1880 1880,e.snapshot 2 1768 1768],by simp only [List.length_cons,List.length_nil]; scalar_tac⟩

def Entry.second (e : Entry) (sizes : Nat → Nat × Nat) : S2W_ExtractionBoundary.Accounts :=
  ⟨List.ofFn (fun i : Fin 7 => e.snapshot i.val (sizes i.val).1 (sizes i.val).2),by simp only [List.length_ofFn]; scalar_tac⟩

 theorem first_index (e : Entry) :
    Slice.index_usize e.first 0#usize = ok (e.snapshot 0 58295 58295) ∧
    Slice.index_usize e.first 1#usize = ok (e.snapshot 1 1880 1880) ∧
    Slice.index_usize e.first 2#usize = ok (e.snapshot 2 1768 1768) := by
  exact ⟨rfl,rfl,rfl⟩

/-- Alias exclusion follows from the ACTUAL source privilege guards, without
assuming distinct keys, distinct data cells, or the accountFrame conclusion. -/
theorem first_disjoint (e : Entry) (ops : AdapterRw.Ops)
    (program : S2W_ExtractionBoundary.Program) (data : Slice U8) (saved : alloc.vec.Vec U8)
    (accepted : AdapterRw.r1_pool_adapter.owned.stage1_owned ops program e.first data = ok (.Ok saved)) :
    ∀ a, a < 3 → a ≠ 2 → (e.heap.accounts a).1 ≠ (e.heap.accounts 2).1 := by
  obtain ⟨pa,pu,ca,ip,iu,ic,rp,ru,rc⟩ :=
    S2W_EntryPrivileges.accepted_privileges ops program e.first data saved accepted
  have eqp := Result.ok.inj (ip.symm.trans (first_index e).1)
  have equ := Result.ok.inj (iu.symm.trans (first_index e).2.1)
  have eqc := Result.ok.inj (ic.symm.trans (first_index e).2.2)
  subst pa; subst pu; subst ca
  change (e.records (e.handles 0).1).owned.is_writable = false at rp
  change (e.records (e.handles 1).1).owned.is_writable = false at ru
  change (e.records (e.handles 2).1).owned.is_writable = true at rc
  intro a within different same
  change (e.handles a).1 = (e.handles 2).1 at same
  have cases : a = 0 ∨ a = 1 := by omega
  rcases cases with h | h
  · subst a; rw [same,rc] at rp; cases rp
  · subst a; rw [same,rc] at ru; cases ru

/-- The destination length is derived from the SAME accepted checkpoint read
and the native wrapper's deferred-length branch; no entrySize premise. -/
theorem checkpoint_size (e : Entry) (ops : AdapterRw.Ops)
    (program : S2W_ExtractionBoundary.Program) (data : Slice U8) (saved : alloc.vec.Vec U8)
    (accepted : AdapterRw.r1_pool_adapter.owned.stage1_owned ops program e.first data = ok (.Ok saved)) :
    (e.heap.payload (e.heap.accounts 2).1).descriptor.length = 1768 := by
  obtain ⟨ca,bytes,ic,read,_⟩ := AdapterRw.Cuts.stage1_checkpoint_length ops program e.first data saved accepted
  have eqc := Result.ok.inj (ic.symm.trans (first_index e).2.2)
  subst ca
  obtain ⟨copied,stored,_⟩ := S2W.SnapshotJoin.data_success ops (e.snapshot 2 1768 1768) bytes read
  change (if (e.buffers (e.handles 2).1).val.length = 1768 ∨
      (e.buffers (e.handles 2).1).val.length = 1768 then core.result.Result.Ok (e.buffers (e.handles 2).1)
      else core.result.Result.Err AdapterRw.solana_program_error.ProgramError.InvalidAccountData) =
      core.result.Result.Ok copied at stored
  split at stored
  · rename_i size
    exact size.elim id id
  · cases stored

/-- Canonical byte representation of the original native account buffer. -/
theorem payload_bytes (e : Entry) (c : Nat) :
    payloadBytes encode (e.payload c) (e.payload c).descriptor.length = bytesOf (e.buffers c).val := by
  change payloadBytes encode (source (nativeBytes (e.buffers c))) (e.buffers c).val.length = _
  have size : (nativeBytes (e.buffers c)).length = (e.buffers c).val.length := by
    simp only [nativeBytes,List.length_map]
  rw [← size,source_bytes,vector_representation]

/-- The SDK data descriptor exposes exactly the original finite native buffer,
not a post-execution read of an allegedly identical allocation. -/
theorem native_buffer {W : Type} (e : Entry) (L : Library W (Nat → Record))
    (sdk : S2TrustedSdkBorrow L) (w : W) (related : L.related w e.heap)
    (valid : Valid e.heap) (a : Nat) :
    payloadBytes encode (L.cellPayload w (L.accountData w a))
      (L.cellPayload w (L.accountData w a)).descriptor.length =
      bytesOf (e.buffers (e.handles a).1).val := by
  rw [(sdk.account_data_cell w e.heap related valid a a).1,
    sdk.cell_payload w e.heap related valid (e.heap.accounts a).1]
  exact payload_bytes e (e.handles a).1

namespace AspisR1.S2W_D189Wrappers
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result S2Trust S2W_D189Entry
open S2W_TrustedStd S2W_WrapperLaws S2W_ReturnedCheckpoint S2W_CommittedCheckpoint

/-- Runtime allocator interface on its private region. P2-P4 admit this
separation from account cells. Allocation or cleanup failure aborts; the
caller proves nothing about an aborted transaction's committed accounts. -/
structure Allocator (A : Type) where
  allocate : A → Nat → Result A
  cleanup : A → Result A

def reserve {A : Type} (allocator : Allocator A) : List Nat → A → Result A
  | [], state => ok state
  | size :: sizes, state => S2W_Trace.thenResult (allocator.allocate state size)
      (fun next => reserve allocator sizes next)

def admittedSizes (e : Entry) (count : Nat) (sizes : Nat → Nat × Nat) : List Nat :=
  (List.range count).filterMap (fun a =>
    let len := (e.buffers (e.handles a).1).val.length
    if len = (sizes a).1 ∨ len = (sizes a).2 then some len else none)

def firstSizes : Nat → Nat × Nat
  | 0 => (58295,58295) | 1 => (1880,1880) | _ => (1768,1768)

def secondSizes : Nat → Nat × Nat
  | 0 => (58295,58295) | 1 => (384,384) | 2 => (192,192)
  | 3 => (768,768) | 4 => (128,256) | 5 => (192,320) | _ => (1768,1768)

/-- Account-only state extension of std Vec allocation/cleanup. to_vec's
complete byte law is Snapshot.to_vec_identity; the allocator does not receive
an AccountInfo or a heap capability. This is the runtime allocator premise's
interpretation, not a claim that allocator state remains unchanged. -/
def allocateSnapshots {A : Type} (allocator : Allocator A) (e : Entry)
    (count : Nat) (sizes : Nat → Nat × Nat) (state : A) :
    Result (A × Heap (Nat → Record)) :=
  S2W_Trace.thenResult (reserve allocator (admittedSizes e count sizes) state)
    (fun next => ok (next,e.heap))

 theorem allocation_frame {A : Type} (allocator : Allocator A) (e : Entry)
    (count : Nat) (sizes : Nat → Nat × Nat) (state next : A) (heap : Heap (Nat → Record))
    (returned : allocateSnapshots allocator e count sizes state = ok (next,heap)) :
    heap = e.heap := by
  unfold allocateSnapshots at returned
  cases allocated : reserve allocator (admittedSizes e count sizes) state with
  | fail error => simp [allocated,S2W_Trace.thenResult] at returned
  | div => simp [allocated,S2W_Trace.thenResult] at returned
  | ok value =>
    simp only [allocated,S2W_Trace.thenResult] at returned
    exact (congrArg Prod.snd (Result.ok.inj returned)).symm

/-- The native first wrapper: same snapshot bounds, owned call, one mutable
borrow/copy/drop, then owned-Vec cleanup. SDK acquisition/drop use the approved
interpretation; bulk copy is the separately named TrustedStd primitive. -/
def first {A : Type} (native : S2W_ExtractionBoundary.First)
    (copy : Heap (Nat → Record) → Nat → Payload → Outcome (Nat → Record))
    (allocator : Allocator A) (e : Entry) (program : S2W_ExtractionBoundary.Program)
    (data : Slice U8) (state : A) :
    Result (core.result.Result (alloc.vec.Vec U8 × Heap (Nat → Record) × A) AdapterRw.Cuts.PE) := do
  let allocated ← reserve allocator (admittedSizes e 3 firstSizes) state
  let result ← native program e.first data
  match result with
  | .Err error => ok (.Err error)
  | .Ok saved =>
    match copy (acquire e.heap (e.heap.accounts 2).1 0 0 .exclusive) (e.heap.accounts 2).1
        (source (nativeBytes saved)) with
    | .panic => .fail .assertionFailure
    | .returned written =>
      let cleaned ← allocator.cleanup allocated
      ok (.Ok (saved,release written (exclusiveGuard e.heap 2 0 0),cleaned))

def second {A : Type} (native : S2W_ExtractionBoundary.Second)
    (allocator : Allocator A) (e : Entry) (program : S2W_ExtractionBoundary.Program)
    (data : Slice U8) (slot : S2W_ExtractionBoundary.Slot) (state : A) :
    Result (core.result.Result (Heap (Nat → Record) × A) AdapterRw.Cuts.PE) := do
  let allocated ← reserve allocator (admittedSizes e 7 secondSizes) state
  let result ← native program (e.second secondSizes) data slot
  match result with
  | .Err error => ok (.Err error)
  | .Ok () =>
    let cleaned ← allocator.cleanup allocated
    ok (.Ok (e.heap,cleaned))

/-- Invert wrapper acceptance. The actual returned heap is derived from the
single trusted std copy; no savedAtWrite or after-account observation supplied. -/
theorem first_accepted {A : Type} (native : S2W_ExtractionBoundary.First)
    (copy : Heap (Nat → Record) → Nat → Payload → Outcome (Nat → Record))
    (std : TrustedStd copy) (allocator : Allocator A) (e : Entry)
    (program : S2W_ExtractionBoundary.Program) (data : Slice U8) (state final : A)
    (saved : alloc.vec.Vec U8) (after : Heap (Nat → Record))
    (accepted : first native copy allocator e program data state = ok (.Ok (saved,after,final))) :
    native program e.first data = ok (.Ok saved) ∧
    after = writeBracket e.heap 2 0 0 (source (nativeBytes saved)) := by
  unfold first at accepted
  obtain ⟨allocated,_,rest⟩ := AdapterRw.Cuts.bind_success _ _ _ accepted
  obtain ⟨result,called,rest⟩ := AdapterRw.Cuts.bind_success _ _ _ rest
  cases result with
  | Err error => cases rest
  | Ok value =>
    dsimp only at rest
    cases copied : copy (acquire e.heap (e.heap.accounts 2).1 0 0 .exclusive)
        (e.heap.accounts 2).1 (source (nativeBytes value)) with
    | panic => simp only [copied] at rest; cases rest
    | returned written =>
      rw [copied] at rest
      obtain ⟨cleaned,_,returned⟩ := AdapterRw.Cuts.bind_success _ _ _ rest
      have equal := core.result.Result.Ok.inj (Result.ok.inj returned)
      have same : value = saved := congrArg Prod.fst equal
      subst value
      refine ⟨called,?_⟩
      have actual := std.slice_copy_from_slice
        (acquire e.heap (e.heap.accounts 2).1 0 0 .exclusive) (e.heap.accounts 2).1
        (source (nativeBytes saved))
      rw [copied] at actual
      unfold specification at actual
      split at actual
      · have w := Outcome.returned.inj actual
        rw [w] at equal
        exact (congrArg (fun pair => pair.2.1) equal).symm
      · cases actual

 theorem second_accepted {A : Type} (native : S2W_ExtractionBoundary.Second)
    (allocator : Allocator A) (e : Entry) (program : S2W_ExtractionBoundary.Program)
    (data : Slice U8) (slot : S2W_ExtractionBoundary.Slot) (state final : A)
    (after : Heap (Nat → Record))
    (accepted : second native allocator e program data slot state = ok (.Ok (after,final))) :
    native program (e.second secondSizes) data slot = ok (.Ok ()) ∧ after = e.heap := by
  unfold second at accepted
  obtain ⟨allocated,_,rest⟩ := AdapterRw.Cuts.bind_success _ _ _ accepted
  obtain ⟨result,called,rest⟩ := AdapterRw.Cuts.bind_success _ _ _ rest
  cases result with
